AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Hourly scheduled workflow that closes AWS Organizations accounts tagged
  "organizations:account-closure" = "REQUESTED" using an EventBridge rule, an
  EXPRESS Step Functions state machine, and the AWS Organizations API.

Parameters:

  ClosureTagKey:
    Type: String
    Default: 'organizations:account-closure'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
    Description: Tag key that marks an AWS Organizations account for closure.

  ClosureTagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: 'REQUESTED'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 256
    Description: Tag value that requests closure of an AWS Organizations account.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Execution evidence: vended Step Functions log group (kept by design so
  # closure evidence is never destroyed by a stack update or deletion).
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AccountClosureLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/vendedlogs/states/account-closure-workflow
      RetentionInDays: 365

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # State machine execution role (least privilege)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StateMachineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: account-closure-workflow-execution-role
      Description: Execution role for the account closure EXPRESS state machine.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AccountClosureOrganizationsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              # AWS Organizations does not support resource-level permissions for
              # the account enumeration, description, closure and tagging
              # actions, so Resource must be '*' for this statement only.
              - Sid: OrganizationsAccountClosureActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:ListAccounts
                  - organizations:DescribeAccount
                  - organizations:ListTagsForResource
                  - organizations:CloseAccount
                  - organizations:TagResource
                Resource: '*'
              # Only the Logs delivery permissions required by Step Functions.
              - Sid: StepFunctionsLogDelivery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'
              # Only the X-Ray permissions required by the tracing configuration.
              - Sid: StepFunctionsXRayTracing
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                  - xray:GetSamplingRules
                  - xray:GetSamplingTargets
                  - xray:GetSamplingStatisticSummaries
                Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EventBridge invocation role, scoped to a single state machine ARN
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EventBridgeInvokeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: account-closure-eventbridge-invoke-role
      Description: Allows the hourly EventBridge rule to start the account closure workflow.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartAccountClosureExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                Resource: !GetAtt AccountClosureStateMachine.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # EXPRESS state machine: logs are streamed to CloudWatch Logs (LEVEL ALL,
  # execution data included) and X-Ray tracing is enabled.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AccountClosureStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: account-closure-workflow
      StateMachineType: EXPRESS
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn
      TracingConfiguration:
        Enabled: true
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt AccountClosureLogGroup.Arn
      Definition:
        Comment: >-
          Paginate Organizations accounts, select those tagged for closure,
          guard against the management account, verify ACTIVE status, close the
          account and acknowledge it. Runs every hour, idempotent by design.
        StartAt: ListAccounts
        States:

          # ---------------------- Pagination: first page ----------------------
          ListAccounts:
            Type: Task
            Comment: First Organizations page, no pagination token supplied.
            Resource: 'arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:listAccounts'
            Parameters:
              MaxResults: 20
            Retry:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - ThrottlingException
                  - TooManyRequestsException
                  - ConcurrentModificationException
                  - ServiceException
                IntervalSeconds: 2
                MaxAttempts: 6
                BackoffRate: 2
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - States.TaskFailed
                IntervalSeconds: 5
                MaxAttempts: 3
                BackoffRate: 2
            Catch:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - States.ALL
                ResultPath: $.Error
                Next: WorkflowFailed
            Next: ProcessAccountsPage

          # --------------------- Pagination: further pages --------------------
          ListAccountsWithToken:
            Type: Task
            Comment: Subsequent Organizations page, using the returned NextToken.
            Resource: 'arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:listAccounts'
            Parameters:
              MaxResults: 20
              NextToken.$: $.NextToken
            Retry:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - ThrottlingException
                  - TooManyRequestsException
                  - ConcurrentModificationException
                  - ServiceException
                IntervalSeconds: 2
                MaxAttempts: 6
                BackoffRate: 2
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - States.TaskFailed
                IntervalSeconds: 5
                MaxAttempts: 3
                BackoffRate: 2
            Catch:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - States.ALL
                ResultPath: $.Error
                Next: WorkflowFailed
            Next: ProcessAccountsPage

          # --------- Per-account work, isolated by an inline Map state -------
          ProcessAccountsPage:
            Type: Map
            Comment: Inline Map over the accounts of the current page.
            ItemsPath: $.Accounts
            MaxConcurrency: 5
            ResultPath: $.ProcessedAccounts
            ItemProcessor:
              ProcessorConfig:
                Mode: INLINE
              StartAt: GetAccountTags
              States:

                # ------------------- Tag based filtering ---------------------
                GetAccountTags:
                  Type: Task
                  Resource: 'arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:listTagsForResource'
                  Parameters:
                    ResourceId.$: $.Arn
                  ResultPath: $.TagResult
                  Retry:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - ThrottlingException
                        - TooManyRequestsException
                        - ConcurrentModificationException
                        - ServiceException
                      IntervalSeconds: 2
                      MaxAttempts: 6
                      BackoffRate: 2
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - States.TaskFailed
                      IntervalSeconds: 5
                      MaxAttempts: 3
                      BackoffRate: 2
                  Catch:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - States.ALL
                      ResultPath: $.Error
                      Next: RecordFailure
                  Next: EvaluateClosureTag

                EvaluateClosureTag:
                  Type: Map
                  Comment: Inline Map over the account tags (sequential, tiny lists).
                  ItemsPath: $.TagResult.Tags
                  MaxConcurrency: 1
                  ResultPath: $.TagEvaluation
                  ItemProcessor:
                    ProcessorConfig:
                      Mode: INLINE
                    StartAt: IsClosureTag
                    States:
                      IsClosureTag:
                        Type: Choice
                        Choices:
                          - And:
                              - Variable: $.Key
                                StringEquals: !Ref ClosureTagKey
                              - Variable: $.Value
                                StringEquals: !Ref ClosureTagValue
                            Next: ClosureTagMatched
                        Default: ClosureTagNotMatched
                      ClosureTagMatched:
                        Type: Pass
                        Result: true
                        End: true
                      ClosureTagNotMatched:
                        Type: Pass
                        Result: false
                        End: true
                  Next: EvaluateAccountEligibility

                EvaluateAccountEligibility:
                  Type: Pass
                  Parameters:
                    ClosureRequested.$: States.ArrayContains($.TagEvaluation, true)
                  ResultPath: $.TagGate
                  Next: IsClosureRequested

                IsClosureRequested:
                  Type: Choice
                  Comment: Accounts without the closure tag are skipped untouched.
                  Choices:
                    - Variable: $.TagGate.ClosureRequested
                      BooleanEquals: true
                      Next: IsManagementAccount
                  Default: SkipAccount

                # ------------------ Management account guard ------------------
                IsManagementAccount:
                  Type: Choice
                  Comment: CloseAccount fails for the management account, skip it.
                  Choices:
                    - Variable: $.Id
                      StringEquals: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                      Next: SkipManagementAccount
                  Default: DescribeTargetAccount

                # ---------------- Pre-close status verification ---------------
                DescribeTargetAccount:
                  Type: Task
                  Resource: 'arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:describeAccount'
                  Parameters:
                    AccountId.$: $.Id
                  ResultPath: $.AccountDescription
                  Retry:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - ThrottlingException
                        - TooManyRequestsException
                        - ConcurrentModificationException
                        - ServiceException
                      IntervalSeconds: 2
                      MaxAttempts: 6
                      BackoffRate: 2
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - States.TaskFailed
                      IntervalSeconds: 5
                      MaxAttempts: 3
                      BackoffRate: 2
                  Catch:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - States.ALL
                      ResultPath: $.Error
                      Next: RecordFailure
                  Next: IsTargetAccountActive

                IsTargetAccountActive:
                  Type: Choice
                  Comment: Only ACTIVE accounts can be closed.
                  Choices:
                    - Variable: $.AccountDescription.Account.Status
                      StringEquals: ACTIVE
                      Next: CloseTargetAccount
                  Default: SkipNonActiveAccount

                # ----------------------- Account closure ----------------------
                CloseTargetAccount:
                  Type: Task
                  Resource: 'arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:closeAccount'
                  Parameters:
                    AccountId.$: $.Id
                  ResultPath: $.CloseAccountResult
                  Retry:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - ThrottlingException
                        - TooManyRequestsException
                        - ConcurrentModificationException
                        - ServiceException
                      IntervalSeconds: 2
                      MaxAttempts: 6
                      BackoffRate: 2
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - States.TaskFailed
                      IntervalSeconds: 5
                      MaxAttempts: 3
                      BackoffRate: 2
                  Catch:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - States.ALL
                      ResultPath: $.Error
                      Next: RecordFailure
                  Next: AcknowledgeAccountClosure

                # --------------- Post-closure acknowledgement tag -------------
                AcknowledgeAccountClosure:
                  Type: Task
                  Comment: Marks the account so later hourly runs are idempotent.
                  Resource: 'arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:tagResource'
                  Parameters:
                    ResourceId.$: $.Arn
                    Tags:
                      - Key: !Ref ClosureTagKey
                        Value: ACKNOWLEDGED
                  ResultPath: $.AcknowledgeTagResult
                  Retry:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - ThrottlingException
                        - TooManyRequestsException
                        - ConcurrentModificationException
                        - ServiceException
                      IntervalSeconds: 2
                      MaxAttempts: 6
                      BackoffRate: 2
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - States.TaskFailed
                      IntervalSeconds: 5
                      MaxAttempts: 3
                      BackoffRate: 2
                  Catch:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - States.ALL
                      ResultPath: $.Error
                      Next: RecordFailure
                  Next: AccountClosureCompleted

                # -------------- Per-account terminal (no side effects) -------
                AccountClosureCompleted:
                  Type: Pass
                  End: true

                SkipAccount:
                  Type: Pass
                  End: true

                SkipManagementAccount:
                  Type: Pass
                  End: true

                SkipNonActiveAccount:
                  Type: Pass
                  End: true

                RecordFailure:
                  Type: Pass
                  Comment: Failure is emitted in the execution logs by the state machine logging configuration.
                  End: true
            Next: CheckForNextPage

          # ---------------------- Pagination: loop control --------------------
          CheckForNextPage:
            Type: Choice
            Choices:
              - Variable: $.NextToken
                IsPresent: true
                Next: ListAccountsWithToken
            Default: WorkflowComplete

          WorkflowComplete:
            Type: Succeed

          WorkflowFailed:
            Type: Fail
            Error: ListAccountsFailed
            Cause: The Organizations ListAccounts call failed after the configured retries.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Hourly EventBridge schedule targeting the state machine
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AccountClosureScheduleRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: account-closure-hourly-schedule
      Description: Triggers the account closure EXPRESS state machine every hour.
      State: ENABLED
      ScheduleExpression: rate(1 hour)
      Targets:
        - Id: AccountClosureStateMachineTarget
          Arn: !GetAtt AccountClosureStateMachine.Arn
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeInvokeRole.Arn

Outputs:

  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the account closure state machine.
    Value: !GetAtt AccountClosureStateMachine.Arn

  StateMachineName:
    Description: Name of the account closure state machine.
    Value: !GetAtt AccountClosureStateMachine.Name

  EventBridgeRuleName:
    Description: Name of the hourly EventBridge schedule rule.
    Value: !Ref AccountClosureScheduleRule

  EventBridgeRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the hourly EventBridge schedule rule.
    Value: !GetAtt AccountClosureScheduleRule.Arn

  LogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch log group that receives the state machine execution logs.
    Value: !Ref AccountClosureLogGroup

  StateMachineExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the state machine execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn

  EventBridgeInvokeRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge invocation role.
    Value: !GetAtt EventBridgeInvokeRole.Arn

    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt'

  PrivateRouteToNat:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: NatGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Image Builder build instance
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sg'

  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/CloudWatchAgentServerPolicy
      Path: /
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-build-role'

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole

  LifecycleExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LifecyclePolicyExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DeregisterImage
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - ec2:DeleteSnapshot
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - imagebuilder:GetImage
                  - imagebuilder:ListImages
                  - imagebuilder:ListImagePipelineImages
                  - imagebuilder:GetImagePipeline
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-lifecycle-role'

  ElasticBeanstalkPreConfigComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-elastic-beanstalk-preconfig'
      Platform: Linux
      Version: 1.0.0
      Data: |
        name: ElasticBeanstalkPreConfig
        description: Pre-configure the image for Elastic Beanstalk compatibility
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - phase: build
            steps:
              - action: ExecuteBash
                name: installPython3
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - yum install -y python3 python3-pip git
              - action: ExecuteBash
                name: installBuildEssential
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - yum groupinstall -y "Development Tools"
              - action: ExecuteBash
                name: setupBeanstalkDirectories
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - mkdir -p /opt/elasticbeanstalk
                    - chmod 755 /opt/elasticbeanstalk
              - action: ExecuteBash
                name: installBeanstalkDeploymentTools
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - pip3 install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel
                    - pip3 install awscli
        tags:
          CreatedBy: ImageBuilderPipeline

  ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-custom-al2023-arm-cis'
      Version: 1.0.0
      ParentImage: !Sub
        - 'arn:aws:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/${ImageName}'
        - ImageName: !FindInMap [ImageMap, ParentImage, Name]
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: 50
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref ElasticBeanstalkPreConfigComponent
      Tags:
        CreatedBy: ImageBuilderPipeline

  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-dist-config'
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref AWS::Region
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: 'custom-al2023-arm-cis-{{imagebuilder:buildDate}}'
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserIds:
                - !Ref DevAccountId
                - !Ref ProdAccountId
              OrganizationArns:
                - !Sub 'arn:aws:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:organization/${OrganizationId}'
            AmiTags:
              CreatedBy: ImageBuilderPipeline
      Tags:
        CreatedBy: ImageBuilderPipeline

  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-infra-config'
      InstanceTypes:
        - a1.large
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref SecurityGroup
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      Tags:
        CreatedBy: ImageBuilderPipeline

  ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-daily-cis-al2023-arm'
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref ImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ImageScanningEnabled: true
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: 'cron(0 6 * * ? *)'
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_AND_DEPENDENCY_UPDATES_AVAILABLE
      Tags:
        CreatedBy: ImageBuilderPipeline

  LifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-delete-after-6-months'
      Description: 'Automatically delete AMIs older than 180 days'
      ResourceType: AMI_IMAGE
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt LifecycleExecutionRole.Arn
      ResourceSelection: {}   # Manually update after deployment to add tag-based selection
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: DELETE
          Filter:
            Type: 'AGE'
            Value: 180
            Unit: 'DAYS'
      Tags:
        CreatedBy: ImageBuilderPipeline

Outputs:

    Description: ARN of the Image Builder pipeline
    Value: !Ref ImagePipeline
  ImageRecipeArn:
    Description: ARN of the image recipe
    Value: !Ref ImageRecipe
  DistributionConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the distribution configuration
    Value: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
  InfrastructureConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the infrastructure configuration
    Value: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
  ComponentArn:
    Description: ARN of the custom component
    Value: !Ref ElasticBeanstalkPreConfigComponent
  LifecyclePolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the lifecycle policy
    Value: !Ref LifecyclePolicy

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless Maths MCP server with API Gateway, Lambda, and Cognito authentication.

Parameters:
  DeploymentStage:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Deployment stage name for API Gateway.
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-users
    Description: Name of the Cognito User Pool.
  AppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-client
    Description: Name of the Cognito User Pool Client.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref AppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  LambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
      Runtime: python3.12
      MemorySize: 512
      Timeout: 30
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'headers': {
                      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                      'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'
                  },
                  'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Placeholder Maths MCP server'})
              }

  ApiGatewayRestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-api'
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  ApiGatewayResourceMcp:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      ParentId: !GetAtt ApiGatewayRestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: mcp
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi

  CognitoAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cognito-authorizer'
      Type: COGNITO
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  ApiGatewayMethodPostMcp:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ApiGatewayResourceMcp
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO
      AuthorizerId: !Ref CognitoAuthorizer
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub
          - 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${LambdaArn}/invocations'
          - LambdaArn: !GetAtt LambdaFunction.Arn
        PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_MATCH

  ApiGatewayMethodOptionsMcp:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ApiGatewayResourceMcp
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_TEMPLATES
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'POST,OPTIONS'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,Authorization'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ''
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true

  ApiGatewayMethodGetRoot:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      ResourceId: !GetAtt ApiGatewayRestApi.RootResourceId
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_TEMPLATES
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"status": "healthy", "message": "Maths MCP server is running"}'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty

  LambdaPermissionApiGatewayPost:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub
        - 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ApiId}/*/POST/mcp'
        - ApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi

  ApiGatewayDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - ApiGatewayMethodPostMcp
      - ApiGatewayMethodOptionsMcp
      - ApiGatewayMethodGetRoot
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGatewayRestApi
      StageName: !Ref DeploymentStage

Outputs:
  ApiUrl:
    Description: API Gateway endpoint URL for the deployed stage.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${ApiGatewayRestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${DeploymentStage}'
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito User Pool ID.
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: Cognito User Pool Client ID.
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained RAPIDS AI SageMaker notebook instance environment (ml.t3.medium, 50 GB,
  named "rapidsai") with its own VPC, public subnet for NAT egress, private subnet for the
  notebook, route tables, and security group, an IAM execution role carrying the
  AmazonSageMakerFullAccess managed policy, and a lifecycle configuration that installs a
  RAPIDS AI conda environment and registers a Jupyter kernel on instance creation and on
  every start. The notebook instance clones https://github.com/rapidsai/notebooks as its
  default code repository. All resources are created by this template; no pre-existing
  infrastructure is referenced.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking - provisioned here because the target account is greenfield and no
  # VPC, subnet or security group can be assumed to exist. The notebook runs in a
  # private subnet with egress through a NAT gateway; no public IP is auto-assigned.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  RAPIDSVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.42.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: rapidsai-vpc
        - Key: Application
          Value: rapidsai
        - Key: Environment
          Value: development
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  RAPIDSInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: rapidsai-igw
        - Key: Application
          Value: rapidsai
        - Key: Environment
          Value: development
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  RAPIDSVPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RAPIDSVPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref RAPIDSInternetGateway

  # Public subnet - hosts only the NAT gateway and routes to the internet gateway.
  RAPIDSPublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RAPIDSVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.42.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: rapidsai-public-subnet
        - Key: Application
          Value: rapidsai
        - Key: Environment
          Value: development
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  RAPIDSPublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RAPIDSVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: rapidsai-public-rt
        - Key: Application
          Value: rapidsai
        - Key: Environment
          Value: development
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  RAPIDSPublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: RAPIDSVPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RAPIDSPublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref RAPIDSInternetGateway

  RAPIDSPublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref RAPIDSPublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RAPIDSPublicRouteTable

  # Private subnet - hosts the SageMaker notebook instance. No public IP is ever
  # auto-assigned; outbound traffic leaves through the NAT gateway below.
  RAPIDSPrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RAPIDSVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.42.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: rapidsai-private-subnet
        - Key: Application
          Value: rapidsai
        - Key: Environment
          Value: development
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  RAPIDSNatEip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: rapidsai-nat-eip
        - Key: Application
          Value: rapidsai
        - Key: Environment
          Value: development
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  RAPIDSNatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: RAPIDSVPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt RAPIDSNatEip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref RAPIDSPublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: rapidsai-nat-gateway
        - Key: Application
          Value: rapidsai
        - Key: Environment
          Value: development
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  RAPIDSPrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RAPIDSVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: rapidsai-private-rt
        - Key: Application
          Value: rapidsai
        - Key: Environment
          Value: development
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  RAPIDSPrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: RAPIDSNatGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RAPIDSPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref RAPIDSNatGateway

  RAPIDSPrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref RAPIDSPrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RAPIDSPrivateRouteTable

  # Least-privilege egress: DNS to the VPC resolver and HTTPS to AWS service
  # endpoints via AWS-managed prefix lists. No unrestricted (all-IP) CIDR is used.
  RAPIDSNotebookSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for the RAPIDS AI SageMaker notebook instance
      VpcId: !Ref RAPIDSVPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: udp
          FromPort: 53
          ToPort: 53
          CidrIp: !GetAtt RAPIDSVPC.CidrBlock
          Description: DNS resolution to the VPC resolver
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 53
          ToPort: 53
          CidrIp: !GetAtt RAPIDSVPC.CidrBlock
          Description: DNS resolution (TCP) to the VPC resolver
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationPrefixListId: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
          Description: HTTPS to Amazon S3 service endpoints
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationPrefixListId: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.dynamodb'
          Description: HTTPS to Amazon DynamoDB service endpoints
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: rapidsai-notebook-sg
        - Key: Application
          Value: rapidsai
        - Key: Environment
          Value: development
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM execution role for the notebook instance
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  RAPIDSSageMakerExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role assumed by the RAPIDS AI SageMaker notebook instance
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSageMakerToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerFullAccess
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: rapidsai
        - Key: Environment
          Value: development
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lifecycle configuration - installs RAPIDS and registers the Jupyter kernel
  # on creation and re-applies it on every start so it survives stop/start.
  # NOTE: this resource type has no Tags property in the CloudFormation schema,
  #       so no Tags block is declared here (E3002 avoidance).
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  RAPIDSLifecycleConfig:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::NotebookInstanceLifecycleConfig
    Properties:
      NotebookInstanceLifecycleConfigName: rapidsai-lifecycle-config
      OnCreate:
        - Content: !Base64 |
            #!/bin/bash
            #
            # OnCreate - create the RAPIDS AI conda environment and register it
            # as a Jupyter kernel the first time the notebook instance boots.
            #
            set -e

            sudo -u ec2-user -i <<'RAPIDS_ON_CREATE'
            set -e
            source /home/ec2-user/anaconda3/bin/activate
            conda create -y -n rapids python=3.9
            conda install -y -n rapids -c rapidsai -c conda-forge -c nvidia rapids=23.10 cudatoolkit=11.8
            /home/ec2-user/anaconda3/envs/rapids/bin/python -m ipykernel install --user --name rapids --display-name "Python (RAPIDS)"
            RAPIDS_ON_CREATE
      OnStart:
        - Content: !Base64 |
            #!/bin/bash
            #
            # OnStart - re-apply the RAPIDS AI conda environment and kernel
            # registration so they are available after every stop/start cycle.
            # Idempotent: reuses the environment if it already exists.
            #
            set -e

            sudo -u ec2-user -i <<'RAPIDS_ON_START'
            set -e
            source /home/ec2-user/anaconda3/bin/activate
            if ! conda env list | grep -qE '^rapids[[:space:]]'; then
              conda create -y -n rapids python=3.9
            fi
            conda install -y -n rapids -c rapidsai -c conda-forge -c nvidia rapids=23.10 cudatoolkit=11.8
            /home/ec2-user/anaconda3/envs/rapids/bin/python -m ipykernel install --user --name rapids --display-name "Python (RAPIDS)"
            RAPIDS_ON_START

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Notebook instance - ml.t3.medium, 50 GB, named "rapidsai", in the private
  # subnet with direct internet access disabled (egress via NAT gateway).
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  RAPIDSNotebookInstance:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::NotebookInstance
    Properties:
      NotebookInstanceName: rapidsai
      InstanceType: ml.t3.medium
      VolumeSizeInGB: 50
      RoleArn: !GetAtt RAPIDSSageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
      SubnetId: !Ref RAPIDSPrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt RAPIDSNotebookSecurityGroup.GroupId
      LifecycleConfigName: !Ref RAPIDSLifecycleConfig
      DefaultCodeRepository: https://github.com/rapidsai/notebooks
      DirectInternetAccess: Disabled
      RootAccess: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: rapidsai
        - Key: Application
          Value: rapidsai
        - Key: Environment
          Value: development
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

Outputs:
  NotebookInstanceName:
    Description: Name of the RAPIDS AI SageMaker notebook instance.
    Value: !Ref RAPIDSNotebookInstance

  NotebookInstanceUrl:
    Description: SageMaker console URL that opens the RAPIDS AI notebook instance.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${AWS::Region}.console.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/home?region=${AWS::Region}#/notebook-instances/openNotebook/${RAPIDSNotebookInstance}'

  SageMakerExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM execution role used by the notebook instance.
    Value: !GetAtt RAPIDSSageMakerExecutionRole.Arn

  NotebookInstanceSecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the security group attached to the notebook instance.
    Value: !GetAtt RAPIDSNotebookSecurityGroup.GroupId

  NotebookPrivateSubnetId:
    Description: ID of the private subnet hosting the notebook instance.
    Value: !Ref RAPIDSPrivateSubnet

  NatGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the NAT gateway providing controlled egress for the notebook.
    Value: !Ref RAPIDSNatGateway

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Self-contained ECS Fargate microservice that registers itself with a private
  AWS Cloud Map (Service Discovery) namespace so other services in the same
  environment can resolve it by DNS name. The stack builds its own VPC with one
  public subnet, two private subnets in separate Availability Zones, an internet
  gateway and a NAT gateway, an ECS cluster (container insights enabled), a
  security group that allows container-to-container traffic inside the VPC,
  CloudWatch Logs, task execution and task IAM roles, in-VPC interface/gateway
  VPC endpoints (ECR API, ECR Docker, CloudWatch Logs, S3), a Cloud Map private
  DNS namespace and service (SRV record), an ECS service, and CPU-based step
  auto scaling between 2 and 10 tasks driven by two CloudWatch alarms.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment name used to name and namespace the resources.

  ServiceName:
    Type: String
    Default: microservice
    Description: Name of the microservice. Also used as the container name.

  ContainerImage:
    Type: String
    Default: nginx:latest
    Description: Public container image to run (for example nginx:latest).

  ContainerPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 65535
    Description: TCP port the container listens on.

  TaskCpu:
    Type: String
    Default: '256'
    Description: Fargate task CPU units (256 = 0.25 vCPU).

  TaskMemory:
    Type: String
    Default: '512'
    Description: Fargate task memory in MiB (must be valid for the chosen CPU).

  DesiredTaskCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 2
    MaxValue: 10
    Description: Desired number of ECS tasks. Must stay between 2 and 10.

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC created by this stack.

  PublicSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet. Must be contained within VpcCidr.

  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the first private subnet. Must be contained within VpcCidr.

  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the second private subnet. Must be contained within VpcCidr.

  AdditionalTaskPolicyArns:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: >
      Optional comma separated list of IAM managed policy ARNs to attach to the
      container task role for accessing other AWS resources. Leave empty to
      attach none.

Conditions:
  HasAdditionalTaskPolicies: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Join ['', !Ref AdditionalTaskPolicyArns]
      - ''

Resources:

  ############################################################
  # Networking
  ############################################################

  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-igw'

  VpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-public-1'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-2'

  NatEip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-nat-eip'

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-nat'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-public-rt'

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-rt'

  PrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  ############################################################
  # Security group for the containers
  ############################################################

  ServiceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub 'Allow container traffic for ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - Description: Inbound container port from within the VPC CIDR
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - Description: Allow outbound traffic scoped to the VPC CIDR
          IpProtocol: '-1'
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-sg'

  ServiceSecurityGroupSelfIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref ServiceSecurityGroup
      Description: Self referencing ingress so tasks can reach each other
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort
      ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref ServiceSecurityGroup

  ############################################################
  # VPC endpoints so task startup and log shipping work while
  # egress is scoped to the VPC CIDR only
  ############################################################

  VpcEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub 'Allow HTTPS to VPC interface endpoints for ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - Description: Inbound HTTPS from within the VPC CIDR
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - Description: Allow outbound traffic scoped to the VPC CIDR
          IpProtocol: '-1'
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-vpce-sg'

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  EcrApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

  EcrDockerEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

  CloudWatchLogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

  ############################################################
  # Logging
  ############################################################

  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/ecs/${EnvironmentName}/${ServiceName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30

  ############################################################
  # IAM roles
  ############################################################

  TaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-task-execution-role'
      Description: Execution role used by the ECS agent to pull images and write logs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EcsTaskExecutionLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub '${LogGroup.Arn}:*'

  TaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-task-role'
      Description: >
        Container (task) role. Additional permissions come only from the
        optional AdditionalTaskPolicyArns parameter.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns: !If
        - HasAdditionalTaskPolicies
        - !Ref AdditionalTaskPolicyArns
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  AutoScalingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-autoscaling-role'
      Description: Role assumed by Application Auto Scaling to adjust the ECS service.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonEC2ContainerServiceAutoscaleRole'

  ############################################################
  # ECS cluster, task definition and service
  ############################################################

  EcsCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'

  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      Cpu: !Ref TaskCpu
      Memory: !Ref TaskMemory
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: !Ref ServiceName
          Image: !Ref ContainerImage
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref LogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
              awslogs-stream-prefix: ecs

  ############################################################
  # Cloud Map private service discovery
  ############################################################

  ServiceDiscoveryNamespace:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::PrivateDnsNamespace
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}.local'
      Description: !Sub 'Private DNS namespace for the ${EnvironmentName} environment.'
      Vpc: !Ref Vpc

  ServiceDiscoveryService:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Service
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ServiceName
      Description: !Sub 'Discoverable SRV record for ${ServiceName}.'
      NamespaceId: !GetAtt ServiceDiscoveryNamespace.Id
      DnsConfig:
        DnsRecords:
          - Type: SRV
            TTL: 10
        RoutingPolicy: MULTIVALUE
      HealthCheckCustomConfig:
        FailureThreshold: 1

  ############################################################
  # ECS service
  ############################################################

  EcsService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
      Cluster: !Ref EcsCluster
      TaskDefinition: !Ref TaskDefinition
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredTaskCount
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 50
        MaximumPercent: 200
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ServiceSecurityGroup
      ServiceRegistries:
        - RegistryArn: !GetAtt ServiceDiscoveryService.Arn
          ContainerName: !Ref ServiceName
          ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'

  ############################################################
  # Application Auto Scaling
  ############################################################

  ServiceScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MinCapacity: 2
      MaxCapacity: 10
      ResourceId: !Sub 'service/${EcsCluster}/${EcsService}'
      RoleARN: !GetAtt AutoScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
      ServiceNamespace: ecs

  ScaleOutPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-out'
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ServiceScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        Cooldown: 60
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 0
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 20
            ScalingAdjustment: 1
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 20
            ScalingAdjustment: 3

  ScaleInPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-in'
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ServiceScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        Cooldown: 60
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 0
            ScalingAdjustment: -1

  ############################################################
  # CloudWatch alarms driving the scaling policies
  ############################################################

  HighCpuAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cpu-high'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Scale out ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName} when average CPU is at or above 70 percent.'
      ActionsEnabled: true
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      DatapointsToAlarm: 2
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      Period: 60
      Statistic: Average
      Threshold: 70
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref EcsCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !Ref EcsService
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleOutPolicy

  LowCpuAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cpu-low'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Scale in ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName} when average CPU is at or below 20 percent.'
      ActionsEnabled: true
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanOrEqualToThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      DatapointsToAlarm: 2
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      Period: 60
      Statistic: Average
      Threshold: 20
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref EcsCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !Ref EcsService
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleInPolicy

Outputs:
  ClusterName:
    Description: Name of the ECS cluster.
    Value: !Ref EcsCluster

  EcsServiceName:
    Description: Name of the ECS service.
    Value: !Ref EcsService

  TaskDefinitionArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECS task definition.
    Value: !Ref TaskDefinition

  ServiceDiscoveryNamespaceId:
    Description: ID of the Cloud Map private DNS namespace.
    Value: !Ref ServiceDiscoveryNamespace

  ServiceDiscoveryQualifiedName:
    Description: Private DNS name under which the service is discoverable.
    Value: !Sub '${ServiceName}.${EnvironmentName}.local'

  ServiceDiscoveryServiceArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cloud Map service.
    Value: !GetAtt ServiceDiscoveryService.Arn

  SecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the security group attached to the tasks.
    Value: !Ref ServiceSecurityGroup

  LogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch log group receiving container logs.
    Value: !Ref LogGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Self-contained AWS network backbone for hybrid interconnect demonstrations with OCI primary region'

Parameters:
  VpcCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  SubnetCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.10.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet
  InternalCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/8
    Description: Internal CIDR allowed for inbound HTTPS traffic
  OCIBackboneCIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/8
    Description: OCI backbone CIDR for outbound HTTPS and VPN static route
  CustomerGatewayIP:
    Type: String
    Default: 203.0.113.1
    Description: Public IP address of the on-premises customer gateway
  EnableVPN:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'
    Description: Enable creation of VPN resources (Customer Gateway and VPN Connection)

Conditions:
  CreateVPN: !Equals [!Ref EnableVPN, 'true']

Resources:
  # VPC with DNS support and hostnames
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: HybridBackboneVPC

  # Internet Gateway
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: HybridBackboneIGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Private subnet in first AZ
  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: HybridBackbonePrivateSubnet

  # Route table with default route via IGW
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: HybridBackbonePrivateRouteTable

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # Transit Gateway
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      AmazonSideAsn: 64512
      DnsSupport: enable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: enable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: HybridBackboneTGW

  # Explicit Transit Gateway Route Table
  TransitGatewayRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: HybridBackboneTGWRouteTable

  # VPC attachment for Transit Gateway (no route table property)
  TGWAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: HybridBackboneTGWAttachment

  # Route table association linking VPC attachment to explicit route table
  TGWAttachRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TGWAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  # Security Group
  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for hybrid backbone
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref InternalCIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref OCIBackboneCIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: HybridBackboneSecurityGroup

  # Customer Gateway (conditional)
  CustomerGateway:
    Condition: CreateVPN
    Type: AWS::EC2::CustomerGateway
    Properties:
      BgpAsn: 65000
      IpAddress: !Ref CustomerGatewayIP
      Type: ipsec.1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: HybridBackboneCGW

  # VPN Connection (conditional, static routes only)
  VPNConnection:
    Condition: CreateVPN
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNConnection
    Properties:
      CustomerGatewayId: !Ref CustomerGateway
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Type: ipsec.1
      StaticRoutesOnly: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: HybridBackboneVPN

  # Static route for VPN connection to OCI backbone
  VPNConnectionRoute:
    Condition: CreateVPN
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNConnectionRoute
    Properties:
      VpnConnectionId: !Ref VPNConnection
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OCIBackboneCIDR

  # Transit Gateway route for OCI backbone traffic
  TGWRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OCIBackboneCIDR
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !If
        - CreateVPN
        - !Ref VPNConnection
        - !Ref TGWAttachment

  # KMS symmetric key with rotation
  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow VPC Flow Logs to use the key
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  KMSAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/flowlogskey
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KMSKey

  # CloudWatch Logs group for VPC flow logs
  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/vpc-flow-logs/hybridbackbone
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: HybridBackboneFlowLogs

  # IAM role for VPC Flow Logs to publish to CloudWatch Logs
  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn

  # VPC Flow Log resource
  FlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
  PrivateSubnetId:
    Description: Private subnet ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet
  TransitGatewayId:
    Description: Transit Gateway ID
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway
  SecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security Group ID
    Value: !Ref SecurityGroup
  FlowLogsLogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch Logs group name for flow logs
    Value: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
