final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Hospitality Insights (prod) Amazon Cognito user pool: a Cognito user pool with a
  custom:last_login schema attribute, a Python 3.12 post-authentication Lambda trigger
  that records the last successful sign-in, a browser-based user pool client with a
  24-hour session lifetime, the Admin/RegularUser/PowerUser user groups, a hosted UI
  domain prefix, and optional SAML federation that stays completely disabled while the
  SSO parameters keep their empty defaults.

Parameters:
  ApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Default: hospitality-insights
    Description: >-
      Short application name used to build the consistent naming convention shared by
      every resource in this template.

  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    Description: >-
      Environment name used in the naming convention of every resource in this
      template (prod for the Hospitality Insights production environment).

  DomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: hospitality-insights-prod
    Description: >-
      Prefix for the Cognito hosted UI domain
      (https://<prefix>.auth.<region>.amazoncognito.com). The prefix must be globally
      unique across all AWS accounts and Regions - change the default value if it is
      already in use.

  ApplicationCallbackUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: https://localhost/oauth2/callback
    Description: >-
      Allowed callback (and logout) URL for the hosted UI authorization code flow.
      Replace the default placeholder with the real Hospitality Insights application URL.

  SSOProviderName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >-
      Name of the federated SAML identity provider to create (for example
      "HospitalitySSO"). Leave empty (default) to disable SSO integration entirely -
      no identity provider resource is created.

  SSOLoginUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >-
      SAML metadata URL of the federated identity provider. Leave empty (default) to
      disable SSO integration entirely.

Conditions:
  # SSO federation is created only when an SSO provider name is supplied.
  EnableSSO: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SSOProviderName, ""]]

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # User pool
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub "${ApplicationName}-${EnvironmentName}-user-pool"
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      # MfaConfiguration OPTIONAL requires at least one enabled factor. TOTP
      # (SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA) is used because it is self-contained: it needs no
      # SmsConfiguration/EmailConfiguration block and therefore no external SNS,
      # phone numbers or email identities in this greenfield account.
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      Schema:
        - Name: last_login
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
      LambdaConfig:
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt PostAuthenticationFunction.Arn
      # AWS::Cognito::UserPool uses the UserPoolTags (map) property instead of Tags.
      UserPoolTags:
        Application: !Ref ApplicationName
        Environment: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Post-authentication trigger function
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PostAuthenticationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${ApplicationName}-${EnvironmentName}-post-authentication"
      Description: >-
        Cognito post-authentication trigger that writes the current UTC timestamp to
        the custom:last_login attribute of the signing-in user.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt PostAuthenticationFunctionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import logging
          from datetime import datetime, timezone

          import boto3

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          cognito_idp = boto3.client("cognito-idp")


          def handler(event, context):
              """Store the current UTC timestamp in the custom:last_login attribute."""
              # The user pool ID and the user name are read from the trigger payload on
              # purpose: referencing the user pool from this function (for example with
              # an environment variable) would create a circular dependency, because the
              # user pool references this function's ARN in its LambdaConfig.
              user_pool_id = event["userPoolId"]
              username = event["userName"]
              last_login = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

              cognito_idp.admin_update_user_attributes(
                  UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                  Username=username,
                  UserAttributes=[
                      {"Name": "custom:last_login", "Value": last_login},
                  ],
              )

              logger.info(
                  "Updated custom:last_login for %s in user pool %s at %s",
                  username,
                  user_pool_id,
                  last_login,
              )

              return event
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PostAuthenticationFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ApplicationName}-${EnvironmentName}-post-authentication-role"
      Description: Execution role for the Cognito post-authentication trigger function.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowLambdaServiceToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # The inline Cognito permission is attached through AWS::IAM::Policy (instead of the
  # role's own "Policies" property) so that the role does not depend on the user pool.
  # The user pool depends on the trigger function, which depends on the role, so an ARN
  # reference from the role back to the pool would create a circular dependency.
  PostAuthenticationFunctionRolePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${ApplicationName}-${EnvironmentName}-post-authentication-policy"
      Roles:
        - !Ref PostAuthenticationFunctionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: UpdateLastLoginAttribute
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
            Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  PostAuthenticationInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref PostAuthenticationFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Optional federated identity provider (created only when SSO is enabled)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SSOIdentityProvider:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Condition: EnableSSO
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ProviderName: !Ref SSOProviderName
      ProviderType: SAML
      ProviderDetails:
        MetadataURL: !Ref SSOLoginUrl
      AttributeMapping:
        email: "http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/emailaddress"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Hosted UI application client
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Note: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient does not expose a Tags property (Cognito user
  # pool clients are not taggable), so the Application/Environment tags are applied to
  # the user pool, the trigger function and its IAM role only.
  # Note: the 24-hour session lifetime is expressed with RefreshTokenValidity/IdToken
  # Validity/AccessTokenValidity. AuthSessionValidity is deliberately NOT used for this
  # because it only accepts values between 3 and 15 minutes.
  # Note: no DependsOn is used here - DependsOn does not support conditional targets.
  # The identity provider is ordered implicitly through the !Ref SSOIdentityProvider
  # inside the EnableSSO-true branch of SupportedIdentityProviders below, which is only
  # resolved when the EnableSSO condition is active.
  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "${ApplicationName}-${EnvironmentName}-web-client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Ref ApplicationCallbackUrl
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Ref ApplicationCallbackUrl
      # COGNITO is always present; the federated provider is appended only when SSO is on.
      # Referencing the SSOIdentityProvider resource (which returns its provider name)
      # creates the ordering dependency implicitly, and only inside the active-condition
      # branch, so cfn-lint's conditional-DependsOn check (E3005) is not triggered.
      SupportedIdentityProviders: !If
        - EnableSSO
        - - COGNITO
          - !Ref SSOIdentityProvider
        - - COGNITO
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      AccessTokenValidity: 24
      IdTokenValidity: 24
      RefreshTokenValidity: 1

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # User groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      GroupName: Admin
      Description: Full administrative access to Hospitality Insights.
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  RegularUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      GroupName: RegularUser
      Description: Standard read-oriented access to Hospitality Insights.
      Precedence: 2
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  PowerUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      GroupName: PowerUser
      Description: Elevated (non-administrative) access to Hospitality Insights.
      Precedence: 3
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Hosted UI domain
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Ref DomainPrefix
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Hospitality Insights Cognito user pool.
    Value: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: ID of the hosted UI application client.
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient

  HostedUIDomain:
    Description: Cognito hosted UI domain prefix.
    Value: !Ref DomainPrefix

  HostedUILoginUrl:
    Description: Hosted UI login URL for the application client.
    Value: !Sub "https://${DomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/login?client_id=${UserPoolClient}&response_type=code&scope=openid+email+profile&redirect_uri=${ApplicationCallbackUrl}"

  SSOProviderName:
    Condition: EnableSSO
    Description: Name of the federated identity provider created for the user pool.
    Value: !Ref SSOIdentityProvider

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained AWS Fault Injection Simulator (FIS) chaos engineering stack. It provisions a
  KMS-encrypted CloudWatch Logs log group, a CloudWatch guardrail alarm used as a stop condition,
  a least-privilege FIS execution role, and a multi-service FIS experiment template that blocks
  application network traffic toward a target region and pauses cross-region replication for
  resources tagged ChaosAllowed=true.

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Parameters (non-infrastructure only)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Parameters:

  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: eu-west-1
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}-[a-z]+-[0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS region code, for example eu-west-1.
    Description: >-
      AWS region that the network-blocking chaos experiment is intended to demonstrate isolation
      from. AWS FIS network disruption is scoped by VPC/subnet/target resource rather than by
      region, so this value is used to label and describe the "traffic to the target region"
      intent (experiment description and tag) and never to select a cross-region target.

  ExperimentDuration:
    Type: String
    Default: PT20M
    AllowedPattern: '^PT[0-9]{1,3}M$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an ISO-8601 duration of the form PTnM, for example PT20M.
    Description: >-
      ISO-8601 duration for which the disruption is applied to every FIS action in this template.
      The default is PT20M (20 minutes). FIS action "duration" parameters are ISO-8601 strings,
      not plain numbers.

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Resources
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Resources:

  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer managed KMS key + alias used to encrypt the FIS experiment log group.
  # The key policy never references the FIS execution role: the role holds kms:Decrypt /
  # kms:GenerateDataKey on the key instead, which avoids a circular CloudFormation dependency.
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LogEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed key encrypting AWS FIS chaos experiment logs in ${AWS::Region}.'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          # Account root keeps full administrative control so the key can never be orphaned.
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          # CloudWatch Logs service principal may use the key, scoped to log groups in this account.
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsEncryption
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'

  LogEncryptionKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/fis-chaos-experiment-logs-${AWS::Region}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref LogEncryptionKey

  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch Logs group that receives FIS experiment logs (LogConfiguration.CloudWatchLogsConfiguration).
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ExperimentLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/fis/chaos-experiment-${AWS::Region}'
      RetentionInDays: 90
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogEncryptionKey.Arn

  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Stop-condition alarm. It is built in this template (never a hardcoded or cross-account ARN).
  # The metric is a synthetic "abort signal" emitted by the chaos operator; because nothing publishes
  # it by default the alarm stays in INSUFFICIENT_DATA (TreatMissingData: notBreaching), which is an
  # acceptable terminal state for a FIS stop condition. Publish a value >= 1 to that metric to abort
  # a running experiment early.
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ExperimentGuardrailAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub 'fis-chaos-guardrail-${AWS::Region}'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Stop-condition guardrail for the multi-service FIS chaos experiment that isolates traffic toward ${TargetRegion}.'
      Namespace: ChaosEngineering/FISGuardrails
      MetricName: ExperimentAbortSignal
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Unit: Count
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ExperimentTemplate
          Value: multi-service-chaos-experiment

  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM execution role assumed by AWS FIS. Trust is limited to fis.amazonaws.com with a
  # confused-deputy guard on aws:SourceAccount.
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FISExperimentRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'fis-chaos-experiment-role-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: Least-privilege execution role assumed by AWS Fault Injection Simulator.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowFISAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: fis.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FISExperimentExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              # EC2/DynamoDB describe operations do not support resource-level permissions, so "*"
              # is the only valid resource for the discovery calls FIS performs before injection.
              - Sid: DescribeChaosTargetResources
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGateways
                  - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: PauseReplicationOnTaggedGlobalTables
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:UpdateTable
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:ResourceTag/ChaosAllowed: 'true'
              # Scope the stop-condition read to the in-template alarm ARN. GetAtt (rather than Ref,
              # which yields the alarm name) is required because IAM policy Resource values must be
              # an ARN, an ARN wildcard, or "*".
              - Sid: ReadStopConditionAlarms
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                Resource: !GetAtt ExperimentGuardrailAlarm.Arn
              # FIS writes experiment events into the log group created above.
              # logs:DescribeLogGroups is deliberately omitted: it does not support resource-level
              # permissions and would require a "*" resource, which this role avoids.
              - Sid: WriteExperimentLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub '${ExperimentLogGroup.Arn}:*'
              - Sid: UseChaosLogEncryptionKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !GetAtt LogEncryptionKey.Arn

  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # FIS experiment template.
  #
  # Design notes / open questions:
  #  * All four targets are selected purely by the resource tag ChaosAllowed=true (FIS ResourceTags
  #    filter). In this greenfield account no resources carry that tag yet, so every target resolves
  #    to zero resources at StartExperiment time. The stack deploys successfully; the experiment
  #    only performs injections once matching subnets, transit gateways, buckets and DynamoDB global
  #    tables are tagged.
  #  * aws:network:disrupt-connectivity is used for the connectivity-disruption behaviour on the
  #    tagged subnets, with the ISO-8601 duration wired from the ExperimentDuration parameter.
  #  * UNCERTAIN: there is no confirmed AWS FIS action identifier that disrupts transit gateway /
  #    transit gateway route-table connectivity. The ChaosTransitGateways target is therefore
  #    declared (tag-selected, as requested) but is intentionally not referenced by any action;
  #    verify the current FIS action catalogue before wiring it to an action identifier.
  #  * UNCERTAIN / DOCUMENTED GAP: AWS FIS exposes no confirmed action identifier for pausing S3 or
  #    S3 cross-region replication. No such action is declared here, and no S3 replication IAM
  #    permissions are granted by the execution role, because they could never be exercised.
  #    The ChaosBuckets target exists only so that tag-selection coverage matches the request
  #    (it is schema-valid and safe, but it is not referenced by any action). Inventing an
  #    identifier such as "aws:s3:pause-replication" would fail at CreateExperimentTemplate time.
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ChaosExperimentTemplate:
    Type: AWS::FIS::ExperimentTemplate
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Multi-service chaos experiment: block application network traffic destined for ${TargetRegion} and pause cross-region replication on ChaosAllowed resources for ${ExperimentDuration}.'
      RoleArn: !GetAtt FISExperimentRole.Arn
      Tags:
        Name: multi-service-chaos-experiment
        ChaosAllowed: 'true'
        Purpose: FaultInjectionSimulator
        TargetRegion: !Ref TargetRegion
      StopConditions:
        - Source: aws:cloudwatch:alarm
          Value: !Ref ExperimentGuardrailAlarm
      Targets:
        ChaosSubnets:
          ResourceType: aws:ec2:subnet
          SelectionMode: ALL
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: 'true'
        ChaosTransitGateways:
          ResourceType: aws:ec2:transit-gateway
          SelectionMode: ALL
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: 'true'
        ChaosBuckets:
          ResourceType: aws:s3:bucket
          SelectionMode: ALL
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: 'true'
        ChaosGlobalTables:
          ResourceType: aws:dynamodb:global-table
          SelectionMode: ALL
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: 'true'
      Actions:
        DisruptNetworkConnectivity:
          ActionId: aws:network:disrupt-connectivity
          Description: Block application network traffic through the ChaosAllowed subnets.
          Parameters:
            duration: !Ref ExperimentDuration
            scope: subnet
          Targets:
            Subnets: ChaosSubnets
        PauseGlobalTableReplication:
          ActionId: aws:dynamodb:global-table-pause-replication
          Description: Pause cross-region replication on the ChaosAllowed DynamoDB global tables.
          Parameters:
            duration: !Ref ExperimentDuration
          Targets:
            GlobalTables: ChaosGlobalTables
      LogConfiguration:
        LogSchemaVersion: 2
        CloudWatchLogsConfiguration:
          LogGroupArn: !GetAtt ExperimentLogGroup.Arn

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Outputs:

  ExperimentTemplateId:
    Description: Identifier of the created FIS experiment template.
    Value: !Ref ChaosExperimentTemplate

  FISExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by AWS FIS to execute the experiment.
    Value: !GetAtt FISExperimentRole.Arn

  ExperimentLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group receiving FIS experiment logs.
    Value: !Ref ExperimentLogGroup

  ExperimentLogGroupArn:
    Description: ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group receiving FIS experiment logs.
    Value: !GetAtt ExperimentLogGroup.Arn

  LogEncryptionKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key that encrypts the FIS experiment log group.
    Value: !GetAtt LogEncryptionKey.Arn

  LogEncryptionKeyAlias:
    Description: Alias of the KMS key that encrypts the FIS experiment log group.

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Landing zone hub VPC for multi-account spoke attachment. Provisions a VPC with
  public and private subnets across two Availability Zones, NAT gateways for
  private egress, a Transit Gateway with a VPC attachment and spoke routes, VPC
  flow logs delivered to CloudWatch, and interface/gateway VPC endpoints for
  SSM, EC2 Messages, SSM Messages, CloudWatch Logs and S3.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: landing-zone
    Description: Name prefix applied to every resource created by this template.
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 32
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be 3-32 characters, lowercase alphanumeric characters or hyphens, and
      must start and end with an alphanumeric character.

Resources:

  ##########################################################################
  # Networking core
  ##########################################################################

  HubVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-hub-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-hub-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  ##########################################################################
  # Public subnets (one per AZ) - IGW-routed, no subnet-level public IP
  # auto-assignment. Instances that need a public IP must set
  # AssociatePublicIpAddress at the instance or launch template level.
  ##########################################################################

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs
          Ref: AWS::Region
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs
          Ref: AWS::Region
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  ##########################################################################
  # Private subnets (one per AZ) - no public IP auto-assignment
  ##########################################################################

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.10.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs
          Ref: AWS::Region
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.11.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs
          Ref: AWS::Region
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  ##########################################################################
  # NAT gateways (one per AZ, in the matching public subnet)
  ##########################################################################

  NatGatewayEip1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGatewayEip2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEip1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      ConnectivityType: public
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEip2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      ConnectivityType: public
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  ##########################################################################
  # Public routing
  ##########################################################################

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  ##########################################################################
  # Private routing (NAT egress per AZ + spoke traffic via Transit Gateway)
  ##########################################################################

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PrivateDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  ##########################################################################
  # Transit Gateway for multi-account spoke attachment
  ##########################################################################

  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub '${EnvironmentName} hub transit gateway for spoke attachments'
      AmazonSideAsn: 64512
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: enable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: enable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-tgw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  TransitGatewayVpcAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-tgw-vpc-attachment'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSpokeRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/8
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGatewayVpcAttachment

  PrivateSpokeRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/8
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGatewayVpcAttachment

  ##########################################################################
  # VPC flow logs to CloudWatch Logs
  ##########################################################################

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/${EnvironmentName}-hub-vpc-flow-logs'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-hub-vpc-flow-logs'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs-role'
      Description: !Sub 'Allows VPC Flow Logs to publish to CloudWatch Logs for ${EnvironmentName}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowVpcFlowLogsAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsDelivery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn}:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref HubVpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-hub-vpc-flow-log'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  ##########################################################################
  # VPC endpoints for private subnet access to AWS services
  ##########################################################################

  VpcEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-endpoints-sg'
      GroupDescription: !Sub 'HTTPS access to interface VPC endpoints in the ${EnvironmentName} hub VPC'
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: HTTPS from the hub VPC CIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: HTTPS responses within the hub VPC CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-endpoints-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  SsmEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-endpoint-ssm'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  Ec2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-endpoint-ec2messages'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  SsmMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-endpoint-ssmmessages'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  LogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-endpoint-logs'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-endpoint-s3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

##########################################################################
# Exports for reuse by spoke / workload stacks
##########################################################################

Outputs:

  HubVpcId:
    Description: ID of the landing zone hub VPC.
    Value: !Ref HubVpc
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-hub-vpc-id'

  HubVpcCidr:
    Description: CIDR block of the landing zone hub VPC.
    Value: !GetAtt HubVpc.CidrBlock
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-hub-vpc-cidr'

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of the first public subnet.
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1-id'

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of the second public subnet.
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2-id'

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of the first private subnet.
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1-id'

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of the second private subnet.
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2-id'

  TransitGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the landing zone hub Transit Gateway.
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-tgw-id'

  TransitGatewayAttachmentId:
    Description: ID of the Transit Gateway VPC attachment for the hub VPC.
    Value: !Ref TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-tgw-vpc-attachment-id'

  PublicRouteTableId:
    Description: ID of the public route table.
    Value: !Ref PublicRouteTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-route-table-id'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark Section 3 log-based monitoring stack. Creates a KMS
  customer managed key (with an in-template alias), an encrypted CloudWatch Logs log
  group that receives CloudTrail management events, an encrypted SNS topic for alarm
  notifications, a multi-region CloudTrail trail encrypted with the customer managed key
  together with its S3 bucket and IAM role, and the CIS 3.1-3.14 metric filters,
  CloudWatch alarms, and Logs Insights query definitions.

Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: cis
    Description: Prefix applied to the names of the resources created by this stack.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]{1,20}$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 20

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS customer managed key used to encrypt the trail, log group, SNS topic,
  # and the CloudTrail S3 bucket
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CisKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark log-based monitoring.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'kms:ViaService': !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
          - Sid: AllowSnsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'sns.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'kms:ViaService': !Sub 'sns.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
          - Sid: AllowCloudTrailUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'cloudtrail.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                'kms:ViaService':
                  - !Sub 'cloudtrail.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                  - !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # In-template alias pointing at the customer managed key above. The CloudTrail
  # trail references this alias by its deterministic literal name so that the
  # trail's encryption key value is a plain, non-empty customer managed key
  # identifier (the key is created by this template, not pre-existing).
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CisCloudTrailCmkAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: 'alias/cis-cloudtrail-cmk'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CisKmsKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudTrail event storage bucket
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudTrailBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-cis-cloudtrail-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt CisKmsKey.Arn
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireCloudTrailObjects
            Status: Enabled
            ExpirationInDays: 365

  CloudTrailBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref CloudTrailBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AWSCloudTrailAclCheck
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:GetBucketAcl
            Resource: !GetAtt CloudTrailBucket.Arn
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceArn': !GetAtt CloudTrail.Arn
          - Sid: AWSCloudTrailWrite
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${CloudTrailBucket.Arn}/AWSLogs/${AWS::AccountId}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                's3:x-amz-acl': bucket-owner-full-control
                'aws:SourceArn': !GetAtt CloudTrail.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role that allows CloudTrail to deliver events to CloudWatch Logs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-cis-cloudtrail-cwlogs-role'
      Description: Allows CloudTrail to deliver management events to the CIS CloudWatch Logs log group.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch Logs log group receiving CloudTrail management events
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudTrailLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-cis-cloudtrail-logs'
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt CisKmsKey.Arn
      RetentionInDays: 365

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Encrypted SNS topic for alarm notifications
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AlarmNotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-cis-alarm-notifications'
      DisplayName: CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark Alarm Notifications
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt CisKmsKey.Arn

  AlarmNotificationTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsToPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Multi-region CloudTrail trail. Log-file encryption uses the template's
  # customer managed key via its in-template alias. The property name KMSKeyId is
  # the spelling defined in the AWS::CloudTrail::Trail resource specification.
  # DependsOn guarantees the alias exists before the trail is created (the value
  # is a literal alias name, so there is no implicit ordering edge).
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudTrail:
    Type: AWS::CloudTrail::Trail
    DependsOn: CisCloudTrailCmkAlias
    Properties:
      TrailName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-cis-trail'
      S3BucketName: !Ref CloudTrailBucket
      S3KeyPrefix: cis-cloudtrail
      KMSKeyId: 'alias/cis-cloudtrail-cmk'
      IsMultiRegionTrail: true
      EnableLogFileValidation: true
      IncludeGlobalServiceEvents: true
      IsLogging: true
      CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn
      CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsRole.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CIS 3.1 - Unauthorized API calls (metric filter / alarm / query)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UnauthorizedApiCallsMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.errorCode = "*UnauthorizedAccess*") || ($.errorCode = "AccessDenied*") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CIS
          MetricName: UnauthorizedAPICalls
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: 0

  UnauthorizedApiCallsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-cis-3.1-unauthorized-api-calls'
      AlarmDescription: CIS 3.1 - Unauthorized API call attempts detected (>= 1 in 5 minutes).
      Namespace: CIS
      MetricName: UnauthorizedAPICalls
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic

  UnauthorizedApiCallsQueryDefinition:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-cis-3.1-unauthorized-api-calls'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userIdentity.arn, userIdentity.accountId, sourceIPAddress, eventName, errorCode, errorMessage
        | filter errorCode like /UnauthorizedAccess/ or errorCode like /AccessDenied/
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 20

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CIS 3.2 - Console sign-in without MFA
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ConsoleSignInWithoutMfaMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '($.eventName = "ConsoleLogin") && ($.additionalEventData.MFAUsed != "Yes") && ($.responseElements.ConsoleLogin = "Success")'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CIS
          MetricName: ConsoleSignInWithoutMFA
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: 0

  ConsoleSignInWithoutMfaAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-cis-3.2-console-signin-without-mfa'
      AlarmDescription: CIS 3.2 - Console sign-in without MFA detected (>= 1 in 5 minutes).
      Namespace: CIS
      MetricName: ConsoleSignInWithoutMFA
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic

  ConsoleSignInWithoutMfaQueryDefinition:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-cis-3.2-console-signin-without-mfa'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userIdentity.arn, userIdentity.accountId, sourceIPAddress, eventName, responseElements.ConsoleLogin, additionalEventData.MFAUsed
        | filter eventName = "ConsoleLogin" and additionalEventData.MFAUsed != "Yes" and responseElements.ConsoleLogin = "Success"
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 20

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CIS 3.3 - Root account usage
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RootAccountUsageMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '($.userIdentity.type = "Root") && ($.userIdentity.invokedBy NOT EXISTS) && ($.eventType != "AwsServiceEvent")'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CIS
          MetricName: RootAccountUsage
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: 0

  RootAccountUsageAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-cis-3.3-root-account-usage'
      AlarmDescription: CIS 3.3 - Usage of the root account detected (>= 1 in 5 minutes).
      Namespace: CIS
      MetricName: RootAccountUsage
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic

  RootAccountUsageQueryDefinition:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-cis-3.3-root-account-usage'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userIdentity.type, userIdentity.arn, userIdentity.invokedBy, eventType, sourceIPAddress, eventName
        | filter userIdentity.type = "Root" and isnull(userIdentity.invokedBy) and eventType != "AwsServiceEvent"
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 20

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CIS 3.4 - IAM policy changes
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  IamPolicyChangesMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = "CreatePolicy") || ($.eventName = "DeletePolicy") || ($.eventName = "CreatePolicyVersion") || ($.eventName = "SetDefaultPolicyVersion") || ($.eventName = "AttachRolePolicy") || ($.eventName = "DetachRolePolicy") || ($.eventName = "PutRolePolicy") || ($.eventName = "DeleteRolePolicy") || ($.eventName = "PutUserPolicy") || ($.eventName = "DeleteUserPolicy") || ($.eventName = "PutGroupPolicy") || ($.eventName = "DeleteGroupPolicy") || ($.eventName = "AddUserToGroup") || ($.eventName = "RemoveUserFromGroup") || ($.eventName = "UpdateAssumeRolePolicy") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CIS
          MetricName: IAMPolicyChanges
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: 0

  IamPolicyChangesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-cis-3.4-iam-policy-changes'
      AlarmDescription: CIS 3.4 - IAM policy change detected (>= 1 in 5 minutes).
      Namespace: CIS
      MetricName: IAMPolicyChanges
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic

  IamPolicyChangesQueryDefinition:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-cis-3.4-iam-policy-changes'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userIdentity.arn, userIdentity.accountId, sourceIPAddress, eventName, requestParameters
        | filter eventName in ["CreatePolicy", "DeletePolicy", "CreatePolicyVersion", "SetDefaultPolicyVersion", "AttachRolePolicy", "DetachRolePolicy", "PutRolePolicy", "DeleteRolePolicy", "PutUserPolicy", "DeleteUserPolicy", "PutGroupPolicy", "DeleteGroupPolicy", "AddUserToGroup", "RemoveUserFromGroup", "UpdateAssumeRolePolicy"]
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 20

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CIS 3.5 - CloudTrail configuration changes
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudTrailChangesMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = "CreateTrail") || ($.eventName = "UpdateTrail") || ($.eventName = "DeleteTrail") || ($.eventName = "StartLogging") || ($.eventName = "StopLogging") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CIS
          MetricName: CloudTrailChanges
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: 0

  CloudTrailChangesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-cis-3.5-cloudtrail-configuration-changes'
      AlarmDescription: CIS 3.5 - CloudTrail configuration change detected (>= 1 in 5 minutes).
      Namespace: CIS
      MetricName: CloudTrailChanges
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic

  CloudTrailChangesQueryDefinition:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-cis-3.5-cloudtrail-configuration-changes'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userIdentity.arn, userIdentity.accountId, sourceIPAddress, eventName, requestParameters
        | filter eventName in ["CreateTrail", "UpdateTrail", "DeleteTrail", "StartLogging", "StopLogging"]
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 20

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CIS 3.6 - Console login failures
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ConsoleLoginFailuresMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '($.eventName = "ConsoleLogin") && ($.errorMessage = "Failed authentication")'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CIS
          MetricName: ConsoleLoginFailures
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: 0

  ConsoleLoginFailuresAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-cis-3.6-console-login-failures'
      AlarmDescription: CIS 3.6 - Console login failure detected (>= 1 in 5 minutes).
      Namespace: CIS
      MetricName: ConsoleLoginFailures
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic

  ConsoleLoginFailuresQueryDefinition:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-cis-3.6-console-login-failures'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userIdentity.arn, userIdentity.accountId, sourceIPAddress, eventName, errorMessage
        | filter eventName = "ConsoleLogin" and errorMessage = "Failed authentication"
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 20

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CIS 3.7 - Disabling or scheduling deletion of KMS keys
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  KmsKeyDisableOrDeleteMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = "DisableKey") || ($.eventName = "ScheduleKeyDeletion") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CIS
          MetricName: KMSKeyDisableOrDelete
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: 0

  KmsKeyDisableOrDeleteAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-cis-3.7-kms-key-disable-or-delete'
      AlarmDescription: CIS 3.7 - Customer managed KMS key disabled or scheduled for deletion (>= 1 in 1 minute).
      Namespace: CIS
      MetricName: KMSKeyDisableOrDelete
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic

  KmsKeyDisableOrDeleteQueryDefinition:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-cis-3.7-kms-key-disable-or-delete'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userIdentity.arn, userIdentity.accountId, sourceIPAddress, eventName, requestParameters.keyId
        | filter eventName in ["DisableKey", "ScheduleKeyDeletion"]
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 20

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CIS 3.8 - S3 bucket policy changes
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  S3BucketPolicyChangesMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = "PutBucketAcl") || ($.eventName = "PutBucketPolicy") || ($.eventName = "PutBucketCors") || ($.eventName = "PutBucketLifecycle") || ($.eventName = "PutBucketReplication") || ($.eventName = "DeleteBucketPolicy") || ($.eventName = "DeleteBucketCors") || ($.eventName = "DeleteBucketLifecycle") || ($.eventName = "DeleteBucketReplication") }'
      MetricTransformations:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Shared IAM roles, customer managed KMS key, S3 bucket, GuardDuty detector, registry log groups and CloudFormation registry type activations for multiple EKS deployments.
Parameters:
  EnvironmentAlias:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    MaxLength: 16
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9]*$'
    Description: Optional alias prefix for shared resource names.
  EnvironmentHash:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    MaxLength: 8
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9]*$'
    Description: Optional hash suffix for shared resource names.
  PermissionsBoundary:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:iam::[0-9]{12}:policy/[a-zA-Z0-9+=,.@_/-]{1,128}$'
    Description: Optional permissions boundary ARN applied to every role created here.
  BucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'shared-eks-platform-bastion-bucket'
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 63
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]*[a-z0-9]$'
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket created by this stack for bastion artifact access.
Conditions:
  HasPermissionsBoundary: !Not [!Equals [!Ref PermissionsBoundary, '']]
Resources:
  BastionBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for the shared bastion artifact bucket.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: {AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'}
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
  BastionBucketKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-bastion-bucket'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref BastionBucketKey
  BastionBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Ref BucketName
      VersioningConfiguration: {Status: Enabled}
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - BucketKeyEnabled: true
            ServerSideEncryptionByDefault: {SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms, KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt BastionBucketKey.Arn}
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration: {BlockPublicAcls: true, BlockPublicPolicy: true, IgnorePublicAcls: true, RestrictPublicBuckets: true}
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-bastion-bucket'}
  BastionBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref BastionBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyUnencryptedObjectUploads
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub '${BastionBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringNotEquals: {'s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption': [aws:kms, AES256]}
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource: [!GetAtt BastionBucket.Arn, !Sub '${BastionBucket.Arn}/*']
            Condition:
              Bool: {'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'}
  GuardDutyDetector:
    Type: AWS::GuardDuty::Detector
    Properties: {Enable: true, FindingPublishingFrequency: FIFTEEN_MINUTES}
  KubernetesResourceLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties: {LogGroupName: cloudformation/registry/awsqs-kubernetes-resource, RetentionInDays: 30}
  KubernetesHelmLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties: {LogGroupName: awsqs-kubernetes-helm-logs, RetentionInDays: 30}
  EksClusterLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties: {LogGroupName: cloudformation/registry/awsqs-eks-cluster, RetentionInDays: 30}
  SharedArtifactBucketKeyPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-artifact-bucket-key-policy'
      Description: KMS access for the shared bastion artifact bucket.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: [kms:Decrypt, kms:DescribeKey, kms:Encrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext]
            Resource: !GetAtt BastionBucketKey.Arn
  SharedArtifactBucketAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-artifact-bucket-access-policy'
      Description: Read-write object access to the shared bastion artifact bucket.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: [s3:GetObject, s3:GetObjectVersion, s3:PutObject, s3:DeleteObject, s3:AbortMultipartUpload, s3:ListBucket, s3:GetBucketLocation]
            Resource: [!GetAtt BastionBucket.Arn, !Sub '${BastionBucket.Arn}/*']
  LambdaDiscoveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-lambda-discovery-role'
      Description: Read-only resource discovery role for shared platform Lambda functions.
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundary, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument: {Version: '2012-10-17', Statement: [{Effect: Allow, Principal: {Service: [lambda.amazonaws.com]}, Action: ['sts:AssumeRole']}]}
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess'
  LambdaCallerIdentityRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-lambda-caller-identity-role'
      Description: Resolves the caller identity and inspects CloudFormation and CloudTrail logs.
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundary, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument: {Version: '2012-10-17', Statement: [{Effect: Allow, Principal: {Service: [lambda.amazonaws.com]}, Action: ['sts:AssumeRole']}]}
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CallerIdentityAndAuditTrail
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [sts:GetCallerIdentity, sts:GetAccessKeyInfo, cloudformation:DescribeStacks, cloudformation:DescribeStackResource, cloudformation:DescribeStackResources, cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents, cloudformation:DescribeChangeSet, cloudformation:ListChangeSets, cloudformation:ListStackResources, cloudformation:ListStacks, cloudformation:GetTemplate, logs:DescribeLogGroups, logs:DescribeLogStreams, logs:FilterLogEvents, logs:GetLogEvents, logs:GetQueryResults, logs:StartQuery, logs:StopQuery]
                Resource: '*'
  EksNodegroupDescribeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-eks-nodegroup-describe-role'
      Description: Describes EKS clusters and node groups.
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundary, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument: {Version: '2012-10-17', Statement: [{Effect: Allow, Principal: {Service: [lambda.amazonaws.com]}, Action: ['sts:AssumeRole']}]}
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EksNodegroupDescribe
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [eks:DescribeNodegroup, eks:ListNodegroups, eks:DescribeCluster, eks:ListClusters]
                Resource: '*'
  CloudFormationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-cfn-execution-role'
      Description: CloudFormation execution role for shared EKS platform stacks and registry types.
      MaxSessionDuration: 8400
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundary, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument: {Version: '2012-10-17', Statement: [{Effect: Allow, Principal: {Service: [cloudformation.amazonaws.com]}, Action: ['sts:AssumeRole']}]}
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref SharedArtifactBucketKeyPolicy
        - !Ref SharedArtifactBucketAccessPolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EksAndPlatformManagement
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [eks:*]
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [secretsmanager:CreateSecret, secretsmanager:DeleteSecret, secretsmanager:DescribeSecret, secretsmanager:GetRandomPassword, secretsmanager:GetSecretValue, secretsmanager:ListSecretVersionIds, secretsmanager:PutSecretValue, secretsmanager:RestoreSecret, secretsmanager:TagResource, secretsmanager:UntagResource, secretsmanager:UpdateSecret, secretsmanager:UpdateSecretVersionStage]
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [kms:CreateGrant, kms:Decrypt, kms:DescribeKey, kms:Encrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext, kms:ReEncryptFrom, kms:ReEncryptTo, kms:TagResource, kms:UntagResource]
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alias/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [kms:ListAliases, kms:ListKeys, secretsmanager:ListSecrets, logs:DescribeLogGroups, lambda:ListFunctions, s3:CreateBucket, s3:DeleteBucket, s3:ListAllMyBuckets, s3:GetBucketPublicAccessBlock, s3:PutBucketPublicAccessBlock, s3:GetEncryptionConfiguration, s3:PutEncryptionConfiguration, s3:GetBucketVersioning, s3:PutBucketVersioning, s3:GetBucketPolicy, s3:PutBucketPolicy, s3:GetBucketAcl]
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [ec2:*]
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [lambda:AddPermission, lambda:RemovePermission, lambda:GetPolicy, lambda:GetFunction, lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration, lambda:ListVersionsByFunction, lambda:ListTags, lambda:PublishVersion, lambda:TagResource, lambda:UntagResource, lambda:CreateFunction, lambda:DeleteFunction, lambda:UpdateFunctionCode, lambda:UpdateFunctionConfiguration, lambda:InvokeFunction, lambda:CreateEventSourceMapping, lambda:DeleteEventSourceMapping, lambda:UpdateEventSourceMapping, lambda:GetEventSourceMapping, lambda:ListEventSourceMappings]
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [logs:CreateLogGroup, logs:CreateLogStream, logs:PutLogEvents, logs:DeleteLogGroup, logs:DeleteLogStream, logs:DeleteRetentionPolicy, logs:PutRetentionPolicy, logs:DescribeLogStreams, logs:ListTagsForResource, logs:TagResource, logs:UntagResource]
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*:*'
  RegistryLoggingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-cfn-registry-logging-role'
      Description: Log delivery role for the CloudFormation registry.
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasPermissionsBoundary, !Ref PermissionsBoundary, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument: {Version: '2012-10-17', Statement: [{Effect: Allow, Principal: {Service: [cloudformation.amazonaws.com]}, Action: ['sts:AssumeRole']}]}
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: RegistryLogDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [logs:CreateLogGroup, logs:CreateLogStream, logs:PutLogEvents]
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt KubernetesResourceLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${KubernetesResourceLogGroup.Arn}:*'
                  - !GetAtt KubernetesHelmLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${KubernetesHelmLogGroup.Arn}:*'
                  - !GetAtt EksClusterLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${EksClusterLogGroup.Arn}:*'
  CodeBuildEksIntegrationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-codebuild-eks-role'
