final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates a SageMaker Studio user profile for an MLOps engineer persona together
  with a persona-scoped SageMaker execution role that the SageMaker service can
  assume. The user profile is attached to an existing Studio domain when DomainId
  is supplied; otherwise the template builds its own VPC, subnet, internet
  gateway, security group, and a public-internet-access Studio domain that uses
  the created execution role as its default user settings, and attaches the new
  user profile to that domain.

Parameters:
  DomainId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Optional. ID of an existing Amazon SageMaker Studio domain that the user
      profile is attached to. Leave empty to create a new self-contained Studio
      domain together with its own VPC, subnet, and security group.
  SecurityGroupIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Optional. Comma-delimited list of security group IDs that belong to the
      existing Studio domain VPC. Used only when DomainId is supplied.
  SubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Optional. Comma-delimited list of subnet IDs that belong to the existing
      Studio domain VPC. Used only when DomainId is supplied.

Conditions:
  CreateDomain: !Equals [!Ref DomainId, '']
  UseExistingDomain: !Not [!Condition CreateDomain]
  UseExistingDomainNetwork: !And
    - !Condition UseExistingDomain
    - !Not [!Equals [!Join [',', !Ref SubnetIds], '']]

Resources:

  MLOpsSageMakerExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mlops-sagemaker-role'
      Description: Execution role for the MLOps engineer SageMaker Studio persona.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSageMakerServiceToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MLOpsPersonaPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SageMakerPipelineManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Resource: '*'
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreatePipeline
                  - sagemaker:UpdatePipeline
                  - sagemaker:DeletePipeline
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipeline
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelines
                  - sagemaker:StartPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:StopPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:RetryPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:UpdatePipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelineExecutions
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelineExecutionSteps
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelineParametersForExecution
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipelineDefinitionForExecution
              - Sid: SageMakerModelMonitoringAndProcessingJobs
                Effect: Allow
                Resource: '*'
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:UpdateMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:DeleteMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:DescribeMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:ListMonitoringSchedules
                  - sagemaker:StartMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:StopMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:CreateProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListProcessingJobs
                  - sagemaker:StopProcessingJob
              - Sid: SageMakerModelRegistryManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Resource: '*'
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateModel
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModel
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModel
                  - sagemaker:ListModels
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:UpdateModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackages
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackageGroups
                  - sagemaker:AddAssociation
              - Sid: SageMakerExperimentsTrialsAndLineageRead
                Effect: Allow
                Resource: '*'
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:DescribeExperiment
                  - sagemaker:ListExperiments
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrial
                  - sagemaker:ListTrials
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:ListTrialComponents
                  - sagemaker:QueryLineage
                  - sagemaker:ListAssociations
              - Sid: SageMakerJobExecution
                Effect: Allow
                Resource: '*'
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:StopTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:CreateTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:StopTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:CreateProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:StopProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListProcessingJobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:StopHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:ListHyperParameterTuningJobs
              - Sid: SageMakerEndpointManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Resource: '*'
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:CreateEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:UpdateEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:UpdateEndpointWeightsAndCapacities
                  - sagemaker:DeleteEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:ListEndpoints
                  - sagemaker:InvokeEndpoint
              - Sid: SageMakerStudioAppsAndSpacesOwnedByUser
                Effect: Allow
                Resource: '*'
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateApp
                  - sagemaker:DeleteApp
                  - sagemaker:DescribeApp
                  - sagemaker:ListApps
                  - sagemaker:CreateSpace
                  - sagemaker:UpdateSpace
                  - sagemaker:DeleteSpace
                  - sagemaker:DescribeSpace
                  - sagemaker:ListSpaces
                  - sagemaker:DescribeUserProfile
                  - sagemaker:ListUserProfiles
                  - sagemaker:DescribeDomain
                  - sagemaker:ListDomains
                  - sagemaker:DescribeStudioLifecycleConfig
                  - sagemaker:ListStudioLifecycleConfigs
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    sagemaker:ResourceTag/Owner: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mlops-engineer'

  MLOpsSageMakerExecutionRolePassRolePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mlops-passrole-policy'
      Roles:
        - !Ref MLOpsSageMakerExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: PassPersonaSageMakerExecutionRoleToSageMaker
            Effect: Allow
            Resource: !GetAtt MLOpsSageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
            Action:
              - iam:PassRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                iam:PassedToService: sagemaker.amazonaws.com

  StudioVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mlops-studio-vpc'

  StudioSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref StudioVpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mlops-studio-subnet'

  StudioInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mlops-studio-igw'

  StudioVpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref StudioVpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref StudioInternetGateway

  StudioRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref StudioVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mlops-studio-rt'

  StudioInternetRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateDomain
    DependsOn: StudioVpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref StudioRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref StudioInternetGateway

  StudioSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref StudioSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref StudioRouteTable

  StudioSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for the MLOps engineer SageMaker Studio domain.
      VpcId: !Ref StudioVpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: '-1'
          CidrIp: !GetAtt StudioVpc.CidrBlock
          Description: Allow outbound traffic within the Studio VPC only.
        - IpProtocol: '-1'
          DestinationPrefixListId: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
          Description: Allow outbound access to Amazon S3 through the regional prefix list.
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mlops-studio-sg'

  StudioSecurityGroupSelfIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref StudioSecurityGroup
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref StudioSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: '-1'
      Description: Allow intra-security-group communication required by SageMaker Studio.

  StudioDomain:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::Domain
    Condition: CreateDomain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      DomainName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mlops-studio-domain'
      AuthMode: IAM
      AppNetworkAccessType: PublicInternetOnly
      VpcId: !Ref StudioVpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref StudioSubnet
      DefaultUserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt MLOpsSageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
        SecurityGroups:
          - !Ref StudioSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mlops-engineer'

  MLOpsUserProfile:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::UserProfile
    Properties:
      DomainId: !If [CreateDomain, !Ref StudioDomain, !Ref DomainId]
      UserProfileName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mlops-engineer'
      UserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt MLOpsSageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
        SecurityGroups:
          Fn::If:
            - UseExistingDomainNetwork
            - !Ref SecurityGroupIds
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Tags:
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mlops-engineer'

Outputs:
  UserProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the SageMaker Studio user profile created for the MLOps engineer persona.
    Value: !Ref MLOpsUserProfile

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained AWS AppSync GraphQL API for Todo with JS resolvers, DynamoDB, and real-time subscriptions.
Resources:
  GraphQlApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: 'TodoAPIwithJs'
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY
  ApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQlApi.ApiId
  Schema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQlApi.ApiId
      Definition: |-
        type Todo {
          id: ID!
          owner: String!
          title: String!
          completed: Boolean!
        }
        input CreateTodoInput {
          id: ID
          owner: String!
          title: String!
          completed: Boolean!
        }
        input UpdateTodoInput {
          id: ID!
          title: String
          completed: Boolean
        }
        input DeleteTodoInput {
          id: ID!
        }
        type Query {
          getTodo(id: ID!): Todo
          listTodos(limit: Int, nextToken: String): TodoConnection
          listTodosByOwner(owner: String!, limit: Int, nextToken: String): TodoConnection
        }
        type Mutation {
          createTodo(input: CreateTodoInput!): Todo
          updateTodo(input: UpdateTodoInput!): Todo
          deleteTodo(input: DeleteTodoInput!): Todo
        }
        type Subscription {
          onCreateTodo: Todo @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["createTodo"])
          onUpdateTodo: Todo @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["updateTodo"])
          onDeleteTodo: Todo @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["deleteTodo"])
        }
        type TodoConnection {
          items: [Todo]
          nextToken: String
        }
  TodoTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: owner
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Composite CloudWatch alarms for cross-region failover application monitoring

Resources:
  # VPC and networking for RDS
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: RemittanceVPC

  Subnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: RemittanceSubnet1

  Subnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: RemittanceSubnet2

  RDSSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for RDS instance
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 3306
          ToPort: 3306
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16

  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Subnet group for RDS cluster
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet1
        - !Ref Subnet2

  # IAM role for Lambda functions
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  # Lambda functions
  GetRemittancesFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: GetRemittances
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          def handler(event, context):
              return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'OK'}

  CreateRemittanceFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: CreateRemittance
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          def handler(event, context):
              return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'OK'}

  # API Gateway
  RemittanceApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: Remittance
      Description: API for Remittance application

  ApiResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RemittanceApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RemittanceApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: '{proxy+}'

  ApiMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RemittanceApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ApiResource
      HttpMethod: ANY
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        IntegrationHttpMethod: ANY
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_TEMPLATES

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: ApiMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RemittanceApi

  ApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName: prod
      RestApiId: !Ref RemittanceApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment

  # KMS key for RDS encryption
  RDSKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: rds.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - "kms:Encrypt"
              - "kms:Decrypt"
              - "kms:ReEncrypt*"
              - "kms:GenerateDataKey*"
              - "kms:DescribeKey"
            Resource: "*"

  # RDS Cluster and Instance
  DBCluster:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBCluster
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      DBClusterIdentifier: dbcluster1
      Engine: aurora-mysql
      EngineVersion: 5.7.mysql_aurora.2.12.0
      MasterUsername: admin
      ManageMasterUserPassword: true
      KmsKeyId: !Ref RDSKmsKey
      StorageEncrypted: true
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VpcSecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref RDSSecurityGroup

  DBInstance:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      DBInstanceIdentifier: dbcluster1-instance1
      DBClusterIdentifier: !Ref DBCluster
      Engine: aurora-mysql
      DBInstanceClass: db.r5.large

      MetricName: 4XXError
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: "Remittance"

    Properties:

      MetricName: 5XXError
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1

      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Admin Suite QuickSight monitoring and data-extraction pipeline. Creates seven AWS Glue jobs
  (five Glue 3.0 / Python 3.9 shell jobs and two Glue 5.0 / G.1X Spark ETL jobs), one 3-hourly
  scheduled trigger per job, a private KMS-encrypted and retained S3 data bucket, a script bucket
  that holds the Glue scripts, five CloudWatch metrics streams for AWS/QuickSight metrics and five
  Kinesis Data Firehose DirectPut delivery streams that deliver those metrics into the same data
  bucket. All resources are driven by a single service role assumable by glue, cloudformation,
  firehose and streams.metrics.cloudwatch.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Admin Suite settings
        Parameters:
          - Environment
          - ScriptPrefix
    ParameterLabels:
      Environment:
        default: Environment name
      ScriptPrefix:
        default: Glue script prefix

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - stage
      - prod
    Description: Environment name applied as a tag to every resource created by this template.
  ScriptPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: 'scripts/'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 512
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9!_.*()/-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Use only letters, numbers and the characters ! _ . * ( ) / -
    Description: >-
      Prefix (folder) inside the script bucket where the Glue job scripts are stored,
      for example scripts/.

Resources:

  ###############################################################################
  # KMS key used for the private data bucket
  ###############################################################################

  OutputBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'KMS key protecting the admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId} QuickSight extraction and script buckets'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: admin-suite-cloudformation

  OutputBucketKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref OutputBucketKey

  ###############################################################################
  # Private, encrypted, versioned, retained data bucket for extracted data
  ###############################################################################

  AdminSuiteDataBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - BucketKeyEnabled: true
            ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref OutputBucketKey
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: expire-quicksight-metric-ingestion
            Status: Enabled
            Prefix: 'quicksight/ingestion/'
            Transitions:
              - StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
                TransitionInDays: 30
            ExpirationInDays: 400
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 90
          - Id: expire-quicksight-metric-visual
            Status: Enabled
            Prefix: 'quicksight/visual/'
            Transitions:
              - StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
                TransitionInDays: 30
            ExpirationInDays: 400
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 90
          - Id: expire-quicksight-metric-spice
            Status: Enabled
            Prefix: 'quicksight/spice/'
            Transitions:
              - StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
                TransitionInDays: 30
            ExpirationInDays: 400
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 90
          - Id: expire-quicksight-metric-quickindex
            Status: Enabled
            Prefix: 'quicksight/quickindex/'
            Transitions:
              - StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
                TransitionInDays: 30
            ExpirationInDays: 400
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 90
          - Id: expire-quicksight-metric-action
            Status: Enabled
            Prefix: 'quicksight/action/'
            Transitions:
              - StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
                TransitionInDays: 30
            ExpirationInDays: 400
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 90
          - Id: expire-quicksight-extractions
            Status: Enabled
            Prefix: 'quicksight/extraction/'
            Transitions:
              - StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
                TransitionInDays: 90
            ExpirationInDays: 730
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 90
          - Id: abort-incomplete-multipart-uploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: admin-suite-cloudformation

  AdminSuiteDataBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AdminSuiteDataBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyNonTlsConnections
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AdminSuiteDataBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AdminSuiteDataBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  ###############################################################################
  # Script bucket holding the Glue job scripts
  ###############################################################################

  AdminSuiteScriptBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'admin-suite-scripts-${AWS::AccountId}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - BucketKeyEnabled: true
            ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref OutputBucketKey
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: expire-noncurrent-script-versions
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 180
          - Id: abort-incomplete-multipart-uploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'admin-suite-scripts-${AWS::AccountId}'
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: admin-suite-cloudformation

  AdminSuiteScriptBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AdminSuiteScriptBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyNonTlsConnections
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AdminSuiteScriptBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AdminSuiteScriptBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  ###############################################################################
  # CloudWatch Logs log groups
  ###############################################################################

  GlueJobOutputLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws-glue/jobs/output
      RetentionInDays: 14
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: admin-suite-cloudformation

  GlueJobErrorLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws-glue/jobs/error
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: admin-suite-cloudformation

  FirehoseIngestionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/firehose/admin-suite-quicksight-ingestion
      RetentionInDays: 14
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: admin-suite-cloudformation

  FirehoseVisualLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/firehose/admin-suite-quicksight-visual
      RetentionInDays: 14
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: admin-suite-cloudformation

  FirehoseSpiceLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/firehose/admin-suite-quicksight-spice
      RetentionInDays: 14
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: admin-suite-cloudformation

  FirehoseQuickIndexLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/firehose/admin-suite-quicksight-quickindex
      RetentionInDays: 14
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: admin-suite-cloudformation

  FirehoseActionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/firehose/admin-suite-quicksight-action
      RetentionInDays: 14
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: admin-suite-cloudformation

  ###############################################################################
  # Single shared service role for Glue, CloudFormation, Firehose and metric streams
  ###############################################################################

  AdminSuiteRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}-role'
      Description: >-
        Shared execution role for the Admin Suite QuickSight Glue jobs, Kinesis Data Firehose
        delivery streams and CloudWatch metrics streams.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowTrustedAwsServices
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: admin-suite-quicksight-read
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: QuickSightReadOnlyAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:List*
                  - quicksight:Describe*
                  - quicksight:Get*
                  - quicksight:Search*
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: admin-suite-s3-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListAdminSuiteBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AdminSuiteDataBucket.Arn
                  - !GetAtt AdminSuiteScriptBucket.Arn
              - Sid: ReadWriteAdminSuiteObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:ListMultipartUploadParts
                Resource:
                  - !Sub '${AdminSuiteDataBucket.Arn}/*'
                  - !Sub '${AdminSuiteScriptBucket.Arn}/*'
        - PolicyName: admin-suite-kms-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: UseAdminSuiteDataBucketKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt OutputBucketKey.Arn
        - PolicyName: admin-suite-logging-and-metrics
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: GlueAndFirehoseLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws-glue/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws-glue/*:*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/firehose/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/firehose/*:*'
              - Sid: PublishQuickSightMetrics
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    cloudwatch:namespace:
                      - AWS/QuickSight
                      - AdminSuite
        - PolicyName: admin-suite-firehose-delivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PutRecordsToAdminSuiteStreams
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch
                  - firehose:DescribeDeliveryStream
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:firehose:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:deliverystream/admin-suite-*'
              - Sid: ListAdminSuiteStreams
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:ListDeliveryStreams
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: admin-suite-pass-role
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PassAdminSuiteRoleToServices
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}-role'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService:
                      - glue.amazonaws.com
                      - firehose.amazonaws.com
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: admin-suite-cloudformation

  ###############################################################################
  # Glue Python 3.9 shell jobs (Glue 3.0) - QuickSight extraction
  ###############################################################################

  GlueJobAssetsAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access
      Description: Extracts QuickSight asset access details for the admin console.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${AdminSuiteScriptBucket}/${ScriptPrefix}etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access.py'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 120
      MaxCapacity: 1
      DefaultArguments:
        '--aws_region': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--account_id': !Ref AWS::AccountId
        '--job_name': etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access
        '--output_bucket': !Ref AdminSuiteDataBucket
        '--output_prefix': quicksight/extraction/assets-access/
      Tags:
        Environment: !Ref Environment
        ManagedBy: admin-suite-cloudformation

  GlueJobAssetsMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata
      Description: Extracts QuickSight asset metadata for the admin console.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${AdminSuiteScriptBucket}/${ScriptPrefix}etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata.py'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 120
      MaxCapacity: 1
      DefaultArguments:
        '--aws_region': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--account_id': !Ref AWS::AccountId
        '--job_name': etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata
        '--output_bucket': !Ref AdminSuiteDataBucket
        '--output_prefix': quicksight/extraction/assets-metadata/
      Tags:
        Environment: !Ref Environment
        ManagedBy: admin-suite-cloudformation

  GlueJobFolderAssets:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets
      Description: Extracts QuickSight folder structure information for the admin console.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      Command:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'IAM identities and policies for Cluster API Provider AWS (CAPA) bootstrap with EKS'

Resources:
  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: capa-control-plane-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref CloudProviderPolicy
        - !Ref NodeRegistrationPolicy
        - !Ref ClusterAPIControllersInfraPolicy
        - !Ref ClusterAPIEKSPolicy

  NodesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: capa-nodes-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref NodeRegistrationPolicy

  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: capa-controllers-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ClusterAPIControllersInfraPolicy
        - !Ref ClusterAPIEKSPolicy

Description: "Automated S3 Block Public Access at account level via SSM Automation and EventBridge"

Parameters: {}

Resources:
  # IAM Role for Systems Manager Automation
  SSMAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3AccountPublicAccessBlock
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutAccountPublicAccessBlock
                  - s3:GetAccountPublicAccessBlock
                Resource: "*"

  # SSM Automation Document to enforce S3 Block Public Access
  S3BlockPublicAccessDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: "Enforce S3 Block Public Access at the account level"
        mainSteps:
          - name: enforcePublicAccessBlock
            action: aws:executeAwsService
            inputs:
              Service: s3control
              Api: PutPublicAccessBlock
              InputPayload:
                AccountId: !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
                PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
                  BlockPublicAcls: true
                  BlockPublicPolicy: true
                  IgnorePublicAcls: true
                  RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  # IAM Role for EventBridge to start the SSM Automation
  EventBridgeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartSSMAutomation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:document/${S3BlockPublicAccessDocument}"

  # EventBridge Scheduled Rule (daily)
  DailyS3BlockPublicAccessRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      ScheduleExpression: "rate(1 day)"
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !Sub "arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:document/${S3BlockPublicAccessDocument}"

          Id: "S3BlockPublicAccessTarget"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless AI campaign orchestration platform (Step Functions + Bedrock + DynamoDB + Cognito HTTP API).

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: campaign-orchestrator
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 40
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$'
    Description: Resource name prefix.
  BedrockModelId:
    Type: String
    Default: anthropic.claude-3-sonnet-20240229-v1:0
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
    Description: Bedrock model identifier.
  NotificationEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: alerts@example.com
    AllowedPattern: '^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'
    Description: Alert email address.
  MessagingPhoneNumberId:
    Type: String
    Default: '+10000000000'
    AllowedPattern: '^\+[1-9][0-9]{7,14}$'
    Description: E.164 sender phone identifier.
  EnableSemanticSearch:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Enable OpenSearch Serverless vector search.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.42.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR for the semantic search VPC.

Conditions:
  IsSemanticSearchEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableSemanticSearch, 'true']

Resources:

  CampaignDataKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub '${ProjectName} campaign data key'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: RootAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: LambdaRoleUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${ProjectName}-lambda-execution'
            Action: [kms:Encrypt, kms:Decrypt, kms:ReEncryptFrom, kms:ReEncryptTo, kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext, kms:DescribeKey]
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: StateMachineRoleUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${ProjectName}-state-machine'
            Action: [kms:Encrypt, kms:Decrypt, kms:ReEncryptFrom, kms:ReEncryptTo, kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext, kms:DescribeKey]
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: OpenSearchUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'aoss.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action: [kms:Encrypt, kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext, kms:DescribeKey, kms:CreateGrant]
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'aoss.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
          - Sid: AwsServicesViaKms
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: '*'
            Action: [kms:Encrypt, kms:Decrypt, kms:ReEncryptFrom, kms:ReEncryptTo, kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext, kms:DescribeKey, kms:CreateGrant]
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                kms:ViaService:
                  - !Sub 'dynamodb.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                  - !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                  - !Sub 'secretsmanager.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                  - !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                  - !Sub 'sns.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                  - !Sub 'cloudwatch.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'

  CampaignDataKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ProjectName}-campaign-data'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CampaignDataKey

  CustomerProfilesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-customer-profiles'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - {AttributeName: customerId, AttributeType: S}
        - {AttributeName: segment, AttributeType: S}
      KeySchema:
        - {AttributeName: customerId, KeyType: HASH}
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: segment-index
          KeySchema:
            - {AttributeName: segment, KeyType: HASH}
          Projection: {ProjectionType: ALL}
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: {PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true}
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt CampaignDataKey.Arn

  ChannelRateLimitsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-channel-rate-limits'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - {AttributeName: channelWindow, AttributeType: S}
      KeySchema:
        - {AttributeName: channelWindow, KeyType: HASH}
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: {PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true}
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt CampaignDataKey.Arn

  DeliveryTrackingTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-message-delivery-tracking'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - {AttributeName: campaignId, AttributeType: S}
        - {AttributeName: messageId, AttributeType: S}
        - {AttributeName: customerId, AttributeType: S}
      KeySchema:
        - {AttributeName: campaignId, KeyType: HASH}
        - {AttributeName: messageId, KeyType: RANGE}
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: customer-index
          KeySchema:
            - {AttributeName: customerId, KeyType: HASH}
          Projection: {ProjectionType: ALL}
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: {PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true}
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt CampaignDataKey.Arn

  CampaignAssetsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}-assets'
      VersioningConfiguration: {Status: Enabled}
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - BucketKeyEnabled: true
            ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt CampaignDataKey.Arn
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - {ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced}
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireNoncurrent
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration: {NoncurrentDays: 90}

  CampaignAssetsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref CampaignAssetsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt CampaignAssetsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${CampaignAssetsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool: {aws:SecureTransport: 'false'}
          - Sid: DenyUnencryptedUploads
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource:
              - !Sub '${CampaignAssetsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringNotEquals: {s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption: 'aws:kms'}

  DeliveryCallbackSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-delivery-callback-signing-token'
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{}'
        GenerateStringKey: token
        PasswordLength: 48
        ExcludePunctuation: true

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-lambda-execution'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: {Service: lambda.amazonaws.com}
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: Logs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [logs:CreateLogGroup, logs:CreateLogStream, logs:PutLogEvents]
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*:*'
        - PolicyName: DataStores
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [dynamodb:GetItem, dynamodb:BatchGetItem, dynamodb:PutItem, dynamodb:BatchWriteItem, dynamodb:UpdateItem, dynamodb:DeleteItem, dynamodb:Query, dynamodb:Scan, dynamodb:DescribeTable]
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt CustomerProfilesTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${CustomerProfilesTable.Arn}/index/*'
                  - !GetAtt ChannelRateLimitsTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${ChannelRateLimitsTable.Arn}/index/*'
                  - !GetAtt DeliveryTrackingTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${DeliveryTrackingTable.Arn}/index/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [s3:GetObject, s3:PutObject, s3:DeleteObject, s3:AbortMultipartUpload]
                Resource:
                  - !Sub '${CampaignAssetsBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow

  ParseInstructionFunction:

      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 512
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn

        Variables:
          BEDROCK_MODEL_ID: !Ref BedrockModelId
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json,os,boto3
          b=boto3.client("bedrock-runtime")
          def handler(e,c):
              p="Extract the campaign definition from the marketing instruction below. Return a compact JSON object with the keys goal, audience, offer, tone and channels.\nInstruction: "+e.get("instruction","")
              r=b.invoke_model(modelId=os.environ["BEDROCK_MODEL_ID"],contentType="application/json",accept="application/json",body=json.dumps({"anthropic_version":"bedrock-2023-05-31","max_tokens":1024,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":p}]}))
              q=json.loads(r["body"].read())
              t="".join(x.get("text","") for x in (q.get("content") or []))
              return {"campaignId":e.get("campaignId"),"instruction":e.get("instruction",""),"config":e.get("config",{}),"parsed":t}

  SegmentCustomersFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-segment-customers'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Architectures: [x86_64]
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 512
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          CUSTOMER_PROFILES_TABLE: !Ref CustomerProfilesTable
          OPENSEARCH_COLLECTION_ENDPOINT: !If [IsSemanticSearchEnabled, !GetAtt OpenSearchCollection.CollectionEndpoint, '']
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os,boto3
          from boto3.dynamodb.types import TypeDeserializer
          d=boto3.client("dynamodb")
          z=TypeDeserializer()
          def f(v):
              if isinstance(v,dict):return{k:f(x) for k,x in v.items()}
              if isinstance(v,list):return[f(x) for x in v]
              return v
          def handler(e,c):
              s=d.scan(TableName=os.environ["CUSTOMER_PROFILES_TABLE"],Limit=500)
              i=[{k:f(z.deserialize(v)) for k,v in x.items()} for x in s.get("Items",[])]
              return dict(e,segment={"strategy":"profile-match","customerCount":len(i),"customers":i})

  PredictChannelFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-predict-channel'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Architectures: [x86_64]
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 512
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          def handler(e,c):
              p=[]
              for x in (e.get("segment") or {}).get("customers",[]):
                  a=x.get("channelAffinity") or {}
                  b=max(("email","sms","push"),key=lambda k:float(a.get(k) or 0))
                  p.append({"customerId":x.get("customerId"),"email":x.get("email"),"phoneNumber":x.get("phoneNumber"),"locale":x.get("locale","en-US"),"channel":b})

  AdaptContentPerChannelFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-adapt-content-per-channel'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Architectures: [x86_64]
      Timeout: 90
      MemorySize: 512
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          BEDROCK_MODEL_ID: !Ref BedrockModelId
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json,os,boto3
          b=boto3.client("bedrock-runtime")
          S={"email":"a rich HTML friendly email with a subject line","sms":"a single concise SMS under 160 characters","push":"a short push notification title and body"}
          def a(base,ch):
              p="Rewrite the campaign content below as "+S[ch]+". Respond with JSON only, using the keys subject, body and callToAction.\nContent: "+base
              r=b.invoke_model(modelId=os.environ["BEDROCK_MODEL_ID"],contentType="application/json",accept="application/json",body=json.dumps({"anthropic_version":"bedrock-2023-05-31","max_tokens":1024,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":p}]}))
              q=json.loads(r["body"].read())
              return "".join(x.get("text","") for x in (q.get("content") or [])).strip()
          def handler(e,c):
              base=json.dumps(e.get("parsed") or {})
              v={}
              for ch in ("email","sms","push"):
                  try:v[ch]=json.loads(a(base,ch))
                  except Exception:v[ch]={"body":a(base,ch)}
              return dict(e,variants=v)

  DeliverMessagesFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-deliver-messages'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Architectures: [x86_64]
      Timeout: 120
      MemorySize: 512
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          CHANNEL_RATE_LIMITS_TABLE: !Ref ChannelRateLimitsTable
          MESSAGING_PHONE_NUMBER_ID: !Ref MessagingPhoneNumberId
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os,uuid,boto3
          from datetime import datetime,timezone
          d=boto3.client("dynamodb")
          def handler(e,c):
              w=datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M")
              o=[]
              for p in e.get("predictions",[]):
                  ch=p.get("channel") or "email"
                  try:
                      d.update_item(TableName=os.environ["CHANNEL_RATE_LIMITS_TABLE"],Key={"channelWindow":{"S":ch+"#"+w}},UpdateExpression="ADD sentCount :i",ConditionExpression="attribute_not_exists(sentCount) OR sentCount < :l",ExpressionAttributeValues={":i":{"N":"1"},":l":{"N":"1000"}})
                      s="DELIVERED"
                  except d.exceptions.ConditionalCheckFailedException:s="RATE_LIMITED"
                  o.append({"messageId":uuid.uuid4().hex,"customerId":p.get("customerId"),"channel":ch,"senderId":os.environ.get("MESSAGING_PHONE_NUMBER_ID",""),"status":s,"attemptedAt":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()})
              return dict(e,deliveries=o)

  RecordResultsFunction:

    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-record-results'

      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 512
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          DELIVERY_TRACKING_TABLE: !Ref DeliveryTrackingTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os,boto3
          from datetime import datetime,timezone
          d=boto3.resource("dynamodb")
          def handler(e,c):
              cid=e.get("campaignId") or "unknown"
              now=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
              t=d.Table(os.environ["DELIVERY_TRACKING_TABLE"])
              n=0
              with t.batch_writer() as w:
                  for x in e.get("deliveries",[]):

                      n+=1
              return dict(e,recorded=n,completedAt=now)

  CampaignLauncherFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-campaign-launcher'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Architectures: [x86_64]
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 512
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STATE_MACHINE_ARN: !Ref CampaignStateMachine
          BEDROCK_MODEL_ID: !Ref BedrockModelId
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json,os,uuid,boto3
          s=boto3.client("stepfunctions")
          def handler(e,c):
              try:body=json.loads(e.get("body") or "{}")
              except Exception:return{"statusCode":400,"headers":{"content-type":"application/json"},"body":json.dumps({"message":"invalid JSON body"})}
              ins=(body.get("instruction") or "").strip()
              if not ins:return{"statusCode":400,"headers":{"content-type":"application/json"},"body":json.dumps({"message":"instruction is required"})}
              cid=body.get("campaignId") or uuid.uuid4().hex
              r=s.start_execution(stateMachineArn=os.environ["STATE_MACHINE_ARN"],name=("campaign-"+cid)[:80],input=json.dumps({"campaignId":cid,"instruction":ins,"config":{"bedrockModelId":os.environ["BEDROCK_MODEL_ID"]}}))
              return{"statusCode":202,"headers":{"content-type":"application/json"},"body":json.dumps({"campaignId":cid,"executionArn":r["executionArn"]})}

  CampaignStatusFunction:

    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-campaign-status'
      Runtime: python3.12

      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 512
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STATE_MACHINE_ARN: !Ref CampaignStateMachine
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json,os,boto3
          s=boto3.client("stepfunctions")
          def handler(e,c):
              cid=(e.get("pathParameters") or {}).get("id")
              if not cid:return{"statusCode":400,"headers":{"content-type":"application/json"},"body":json.dumps({"message":"id required"})}
              r=s.list_executions(stateMachineArn=os.environ["STATE_MACHINE_ARN"],maxResults=100)
              x=[{"name":y["name"],"status":y["status"],"executionArn":y["executionArn"]} for y in r.get("executions",[]) if cid in y["name"]]
              if not x:return{"statusCode":404,"headers":{"content-type":"application/json"},"body":json.dumps({"campaignId":cid,"message":"not found"})}

  ProcessDeliveryStatusFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-process-delivery-status'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Architectures: [x86_64]
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 512
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          DELIVERY_TRACKING_TABLE: !Ref DeliveryTrackingTable
          DELIVERY_CALLBACK_SECRET_ARN: !Ref DeliveryCallbackSecret
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import base64,hashlib,hmac,json,os,boto3
          from datetime import datetime,timezone
          sm=boto3.client("secretsmanager")
          d=boto3.resource("dynamodb")
          def handler(e,c):
              h={k.lower():v for k,v in (e.get("headers") or {}).items()}
              b=e.get("body") or ""
              if e.get("isBase64Encoded"):b=base64.b64decode(b).decode()
              s=json.loads(sm.get_secret_value(SecretId=os.environ["DELIVERY_CALLBACK_SECRET_ARN"])["SecretString"])["token"]
              if not hmac.compare_digest(h.get("x-campaign-signature",""),hmac.new(s.encode(),b.encode(),hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()):
                  return{"statusCode":401,"headers":{"content-type":"application/json"},"body":json.dumps({"message":"invalid signature"})}
              try:p=json.loads(b or "{}")
              except Exception:return{"statusCode":400,"headers":{"content-type":"application/json"},"body":json.dumps({"message":"invalid JSON"})}
              d.Table(os.environ["DELIVERY_TRACKING_TABLE"]).update_item(Key={"campaignId":p.get("campaignId"),"messageId":p.get("messageId")},UpdateExpression="SET deliveryStatus = :s, updatedAt = :n",ExpressionAttributeValues={":s":str(p.get("status","")).upper(),":n":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()})
              return{"statusCode":200,"headers":{"content-type":"application/json"},"body":json.dumps({"status":"ok"})}

      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags: [{Key: Name, Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-subnet-b'}]

  OpenSearchEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Condition: IsSemanticSearchEnabled
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub '${ProjectName} OpenSearch endpoint'
      VpcId: !Ref CampaignVpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Outbound HTTPS inside VPC only
      Tags: [{Key: Name, Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-endpoint-sg'}]

  OpenSearchEndpointIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Condition: IsSemanticSearchEnabled
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref OpenSearchEndpointSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
      Description: HTTPS from VPC

  OpenSearchVpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::OpenSearchServerless::VpcEndpoint
    Condition: IsSemanticSearchEnabled
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-aoss'
      VpcId: !Ref CampaignVpc
      SubnetIds: [!Ref CampaignPrivateSubnetA, !Ref CampaignPrivateSubnetB]
      SecurityGroupIds: [!Ref OpenSearchEndpointSecurityGroup]

  OpenSearchEncryptionPolicy:
    Type: AWS::OpenSearchServerless::SecurityPolicy
    Condition: IsSemanticSearchEnabled
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-aoss-encryption'
      Type: encryption
      Policy: !Sub
        - '{"Rules":[{"ResourceType":"collection","Resource":["collection/${ProjectName}-vectors"]}],"AWSOwnedKey":false,"KmsKeyArn":"${KmsKeyArn}"}'
        - KmsKeyArn: !GetAtt CampaignDataKey.Arn

  OpenSearchNetworkPolicy:
    Type: AWS::OpenSearchServerless::SecurityPolicy
    Condition: IsSemanticSearchEnabled
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-aoss-network'
      Type: network
      Policy: !Sub
        - '[{"Rules":[{"ResourceType":"collection","Resource":["collection/${ProjectName}-vectors"]},{"ResourceType":"dashboard","Resource":["collection/${ProjectName}-vectors"]}],"AllowFromPublic":false,"SourceVPCEs":["${EndpointId}"]}]'
        - EndpointId: !Ref OpenSearchVpcEndpoint

  OpenSearchAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::OpenSearchServerless::AccessPolicy
    Condition: IsSemanticSearchEnabled
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-aoss-data-access'
      Type: data
      Policy: !Sub
        - '[{"Rules":[{"ResourceType":"index","Resource":["index/${ProjectName}-vectors/*"],"Permission":["aoss:CreateIndex","aoss:DeleteIndex","aoss:UpdateIndex","aoss:DescribeIndex","aoss:ReadDocument","aoss:WriteDocument"]},{"ResourceType":"collection","Resource":["collection/${ProjectName}-vectors"],"Permission":["aoss:CreateCollectionItems","aoss:DeleteCollectionItems","aoss:UpdateCollectionItems","aoss:DescribeCollectionItems"]}],"Principal":["${LambdaRoleArn}"]}]'
        - LambdaRoleArn: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn

  OpenSearchCollection:
    Type: AWS::OpenSearchServerless::Collection
    Condition: IsSemanticSearchEnabled
    DependsOn:
      - OpenSearchEncryptionPolicy
      - OpenSearchNetworkPolicy
      - OpenSearchAccessPolicy
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vectors'
      Type: VECTORSEARCH

  AlertTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-alerts'
      DisplayName: Campaign orchestrator alerts
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt CampaignDataKey.Arn
      Subscription:
        - Protocol: email
          Endpoint: !Ref NotificationEmail

  StateMachineFailureAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-state-machine-failures'
      Namespace: AWS/States
      MetricName: ExecutionsFailed
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: StateMachineArn
          Value: !Ref CampaignStateMachine
      AlarmActions: [!Ref AlertTopic]
      OKActions: [!Ref AlertTopic]
